title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer, Browser (New Products)
Director, Americas Marketing
description:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.




WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.




MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

DeepL is at an exciting inflection point, and we’re looking for a high-energy, creative marketing leader to own our marketing strategy for the Americas. As the Director of Americas Marketing, you won’t just be sitting in meetings—you’ll be the architect and the builder. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role where you’ll personally execute a regional go-to-market strategy that cuts through the noise of the crowded AI space. We need an out-of-the-box thinker who can bridge global strategy with local spark, making DeepL the go-to choice across the region.

You’ll be a one-person engine room, driving measurable impact across the funnel and partnering closely with Sales to crush regional revenue targets. If you love the challenge of personally launching campaigns that turn heads and win hearts, this is your stage. You’ll be a vital voice in our GTM leadership, translating big business objectives into high-impact, marketing programs.

This role reports directly to the VP of Demand Generation and sits at the heart of DeepL's go-to-market motion.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Regional Strategy & GTM Execution

 - Build and own the comprehensive marketing plan for the Americas, ensuring it is data-driven and aligned with both regional Sales priorities and global marketing initiatives

 - Partner with Global Performance & Campaigns and Digital Lifecycle teams to ensure global channel spend and lifecycle marketing are optimised for the Americas funnel,  sparking high-quality pipeline growth across all segments, aligning with campaign managers to adapt global campaigns for the Americas

 - Drive regional ABM initiatives from concept to delivery, identifying high-value accounts and deploying tailored, creative messaging that stands out.

 - Provide strategic oversight for regional event management and field/partner marketing activities, ensuring events serve as a high-impact secondary channel for relationship building and lead generation.

 - Represent Marketing within the regional leadership team. Hold a seat at the table, building cross functional relationships, co-owning regional strategy with Sales and other leaders and building the regional culture together.

Funnel Analysis & Optimization

 - Own the end-to-end regional funnel analysis, monitoring trends from top-of-funnel traffic and conversions to pipeline health and closed-won revenue.

 - Proactively diagnose funnel friction, lead flow issues, or conversion gaps, and liaise with central teams—including Web, Marketing Operations, and Lifecycle—to resolve leaks and ensure a seamless, high-performing conversion path.

 - Partner with Regional SDR team, executing plays and pipe gen days to ensure regional pipeline targets are met

Collaboration & Execution

 - Operate as a high-velocity individual contributor who partners seamlessly with Global Marketing, Product Marketing, and regional Sales and SDR teams to deliver success.

 - Serve as the creative bridge between regional needs and global functions, advocating for local requirements while executing global initiatives with local flair.

 - Represent the Americas marketing motion at the senior level, owning the results, the budget, and the creative vision for the region.

 - Allocate and optimise regional marketing budget to ensure alignment with regional pipeline and revenue goals

 - Communicate marketing strategies, programs and expectations to regional GTM teams to ensure maximum impact on the business




QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR

 - 12–15 years of marketing experience, with a proven track record in B2B SaaS demand generation and regional leadership.

 - Expertise in building full-funnel marketing plans that support both high-velocity self-serve and complex enterprise sales motions.

 - Strong analytical mindset with a command of demand generation practices, including lead scoring, funnel metrics, and ROI analysis.

 - Demonstrated ability to be a collaborative partner to Sales, helping to translate regional sales goals into actionable marketing strategies.

 - Experience aligning with global functions (Performance, Digital, Field Marketing) to drive regional success within a global framework.

 - Deep familiarity with the B2B buying cycle — including the interplay between product-led growth, self-service revenue and assisted enterprise sales motions.

 - Exceptional analytical skills: you are comfortable defining KPIs, interpreting data and using insights to influence strategy and investment decisions at the leadership level, including applying AI-driven insights and predictive models.

 - Strong cross-functional instincts — you are a natural collaborator who can align diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, including driving adoption of AI-powered approaches across Marketing, Sales, and Product teams.

 - Excellent project management capabilities, with the ability to maintain clarity and momentum across multiple simultaneous campaigns and workstreams, leveraging automation and AI to increase speed and scale.

 - A practical, proactive mindset: you balance strategic thinking with a genuine willingness to get into the detail when it matters, including evaluating and implementing new AI tools and methodologies.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

 - Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

 - Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with several days in the office each week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

 - Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

 - Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

 - Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

 - 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

 - Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.



If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!




WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: Senior Vendor Relationship Manager (Payroll and Compliance)
description:
✨ ONE PLATFORM, A WHOLE WORLD OF OPPORTUNITY



The best jobs have always clustered in a handful of the world's wealthiest cities. But talent is everywhere. Oyster set out to close that gap - building a global employment platform that lets companies hire, pay, and care for brilliant people anywhere.



We're proof that a high-performing culture doesn't need an office. Distributed across 60+ countries since 2020, we've built something the industry keeps noticing:



 - Ranked #10 of 250 on TIME and Statista's 2026 list of America's Top WorkTech Companies https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-hr-named-10-of-americas-top-worktech-companies-of-2026-by-time 

 - Named one of America's Greatest Startup Workplaces 2026 https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-2026-newsweek-award by Newsweek

 - A G2 Spring 2026 Leader https://www.oysterhr.com/library/oyster-named-best-roi-for-any-global-employment-platform-for-g2-spring-2026 across Employer of Record, Global Employment, Multi-country Payroll, and HR Compliance

 - The only B Corp-certified global employment platform ~ independently verified since 2023



Two of those rankings measured our business impact from the outside. One measured how our own people feel about working here. They landed in the same place ~ because at Oyster, culture and performance aren't separate conversations. They're the same one.



And we're just getting started. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who care as much as you do, we'd love for you to apply.



Location: While this position is posted in a specific region, all of Oyster’s positions are fully remote, and you can work from home. Forever. To create the best experience for our new hire, this role requires that you be based within UTC -1 to UTC +3

In this highly strategic and cross-functional role, you’ll own and evolve Oyster’s global network of external payroll partners and core compliance providers that underpins end-to-end payroll delivery across our markets. Operating with a primary focus (~80%) on core multi-country payroll delivery, vendor accuracy, calendar adherence, and operational controls, alongside secondary oversight (~20%) of specialized Compliance vendors, you’ll ensure our partners deliver scalable, high-quality, and fully compliant solutions that enable our customers to hire anyone, anywhere. You’ll combine commercial acumen, operational excellence, regulatory monitoring, and strong relationship management to drive vendor performance, execute risk assessments, resolve complex payroll escalations, and continuously strengthen our global partner ecosystem. From leading commercial negotiations, compliance tracking, and governance frameworks to identifying new partner opportunities and ensuring alignment with local legal and statutory payroll standards, you’ll play a critical role in shaping how Oyster delivers global employment solutions at scale.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and can confidently influence stakeholders internally and externally. You are commercially minded, data-driven, solutions-oriented, and energized by building strong partnerships that create long-term business impact.

Key Responsibilities

 - Act as the Subject Matter Expert and primary operational and commercial owner for Oyster's strategic multi-country payroll partners worldwide.

 - Maintain deep operational mastery of end-to-end payroll delivery workflows, cut-off calendars, variance analysis, Gross-to-Net (GTN) calculations, statutory filings, and failure modes across key markets

 - Partner with internal Pay & Payroll operations teams to monitor partner SLA compliance, data payload delivery, and payroll cut-off adherence

 - Proactively evaluate vendor capacity, operational readiness, and processing controls ahead of peak payroll cycles and expansion into new markets

 - Define partner strategy, governance, scorecards, review cadences, escalation thresholds, and improvement plans

 - Hold partners accountable for payroll accuracy, timeliness, statutory compliance, compliance tracking, responsiveness, controls, and customer outcomes

 - Manage the full vendor relationship lifecycle, from partner selection and onboarding through transition, consolidation, or exit decisions

 - Evaluate partner capabilities, market coverage, operational maturity, security/compliance posture, and scalability

 - Build and maintain expertise in multi-country payroll delivery, regulatory dependencies, and contractual trade-offs

Vendor Performance & Governance

 - Establish baselines and monitor vendor performance through KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, and remediation plans

 - Lead recurring executive business reviews and performance discussions with partner leadership teams

 - Translate payroll-partner performance data into recommendations for Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Customer teams, and leadership

 - Monitor operational performance and proactively identify service risks or quality concerns

 - Conduct structured vendor compliance audits, risk assessments, and operational reviews across the partner ecosystem

 - Drive consistent governance standards, regulatory alignment, and operational excellence across vendors

 - Lead ongoing regulatory monitoring, risk assessments, and compliance tracking to ensure there are no gaps in compliance across all payroll and compliance vendor operations and local legal standards across all operating regions

Commercial & Partnership Management

 - Build trusted, long-term relationships with external partner leadership teams

 - Lead or materially shape commercial negotiations, contract renewals, pricing, remedies, and service changes

 - Strengthen strategic partnerships to support business growth and customer outcomes

 - Lead complex, multi-market payroll escalations through root-cause analysis, recovery, prevention, and executive communication

 - Collaborate cross-functionally and externally to resolve sensitive operational challenges

 - Support customer and internal stakeholder conversations requiring partner expertise

 - Identify and source new partners to strengthen global coverage and capabilities

Vendor Ecosystem Development

 - Identify operational or geographic gaps within the vendor ecosystem

 - Evaluate and onboard new partners to strengthen Oyster’s global coverage

 - Recommend improvements to ecosystem strategy, scalability, and service quality

 - Partner cross-functionally to evolve how Oyster leverages and manages external vendors

 - Drive initiatives that improve partner consistency, efficiency, and customer experience

Strategic Business Partnership

 - Advise internal teams on vendor capabilities, strengths, and operational considerations

 - Guide partner selection decisions based on customer needs and business priorities

 - Share insights from vendor trends, escalations, and operational performance data

 - Partner with Go-To-Market teams to support deal strategy and customer solutions

 - Enable scalable and commercially sound global employment solutions

 - Proactively partner with internal teams including HRBPs, Employee Lifecycle Teams, and Payroll/Pay teams to align vendor capabilities with employee support and operational workflows

Escalation Leadership

 - Maintain secondary oversight (~20%) of specialized Health & Safety and Compliance vendor relationships, ensuring partner capabilities and SLAs support local statutory requirements

 - Lead high-impact escalations across external partners and internal teams with limited direction

 - Coordinate cross-functional and cross-partner responses to critical operational issues

 - Protect customer experience while balancing operational and commercial priorities

 - Identify root causes and recurring trends across escalations

 - Drive preventative improvements and operational maturity across the partner ecosystem

 - Lead in escalations on calls to get to root cause, find solutions, and manage end-to-end resolution.


CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT & HIGH PERFORMANCE

 - Continuously audit and refine workflows and ways of working to reduce response times and elevate service quality.

 - Build scalable processes, knowledge, automation, and AI-enabled reporting while protecting payroll and personal data.

 - Analyze recurring ticket trends and received queries to identify systemic issues, proactively building preventative resources for internal teams.

 - Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and knowledge management, ensuring Pearls have accurate, accessible self-service resources to reduce dependency and improve operational efficiency.



Projects

 - Lead People Services and cross-functional projects as we work towards our Mission to enable companies to hire anyone, anywhere!



Core Requirements

 - 5+ years of direct experience managing multi-country Payroll Vendors and Compliance/Health & Safety partners in a global environment

 - Strong technical understanding of end-to-end payroll processing cycles, Gross-to-Net (GTN) calculations, statutory filings, and payroll controls

 - Significant experience owning strategic payroll and compliance vendor relationships in a global or multi-country environment

 - Deep understanding of payroll operations, compliance tracking, risk assessments, statutory controls, regulatory monitoring, and global legal standards

 - Evidence of improving vendor performance and regulatory alignment through KPIs, SLAs, vendor compliance audits, governance, remediation, and executive business reviews

 - Commercial negotiation and contract-management capability, including pricing, service levels, remedies, renewals, and trade-offs

 - Highly strategic thinker with the ability to balance operational detail with long-term business goals

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to drive decisions and improvements

 - Commercially minded and solutions-oriented, with a pragmatic approach to operational challenges

 - Exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills across internal and external stakeholders

 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced environment

 - Experience managing complex escalations and driving resolution across multiple stakeholders

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal

 - Collaborative and cross-functional by nature, with experience partnering across Operations, Legal, Support, Sales, and Customer-facing teams

 - Process-oriented and continuously looking for ways to improve scalability and operational maturity

 - Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping shape evolving operational functions and frameworks

 - Demonstrated track record of proactive business partnering with internal stakeholders such as HRBPs, Lifecycle Teams, and Pay teams

 - [BONUS] Experience working with global vendors across multiple regions (APAC, EMEA, LATAM, AMER)

 - [BONUS] Experience building or scaling vendor governance programs and operational frameworks

 - [BONUS] Additional languages

 - [BONUS] Have worked in a fast-paced, scaling startup or global tech environment

 - [BONUS] Experience implementing AI tools or automation workflows to improve workflows and vendor management

You'll also need

 - A reliable home internet connection (or be able to get one)

 - Fluent English language




HOW WE WORK TOGETHER AT OYSTER

Our values guide the work we do, the decisions we make, and the culture that makes Oyster what it is. We make it happen—progress is our default setting. We drive change, we build and give trust, and we move as one united team.



Our mission is to create a more equal world of work: helping companies everywhere hire, pay, and care for talent anywhere. Everything we do ladders up to our mission. We embrace asynchronous, collaborative work and share how we operate in the Oyster Public HQ https://oysterhr.notion.site/Welcome-to-The-Reef-Oyster-s-Open-Source-Employee-Guide-fc482e3f107c4afd8c85ed217f1d0c1d so other global teams can learn from us.




HOW YOU WORK

With diverse locations, cultures, and needs, we created How YOU Work; https://oysterhr.notion.site/How-YOU-work-ac16c1932e314ffd8cb693e332458395 a program supporting your whole human experience at Oyster:

 - Work from anywhere: Oyster has no borders or HQ. As long as work is timely, your team is supported, and you're authorized to work where you live, you can work from anywhere.

 - Paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year (including holidays and vacation), or more if required by your country.

 - Mental health support: Access Plumm https://oysterhr.notion.site/Plumm-3b5e7e70dec6428e975f68f25972cfb7, our mental well-being service.

 - Wellbeing allowance: Each month, receive a wellbeing allowance in your ThanksBen wallet to spend on a wide range of options.

 - Flexible parental leave: All new parents are eligible for at least three months’ paid leave, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required locally.

 - WFH stipend: Receive a stipend for your laptop and home office equipment to get you set up quickly.
   
   


✨ THE BEST JOBS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE TO EVERYONE 

We embrace diverse perspectives and intentionally build our product and company with an inclusive, global mindset. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every criterion, and are committed to a trust-based, thriving environment.



Oyster is committed to ensuring equal opportunity of employment for qualified persons with disabilities and actively fosters an inclusive work environment. If you require reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process, please email jobs@oysterhr.com with the subject line: Interview Accommodations.



Our available positions are on our careers page. Our team will only contact you from an @oysterhr.com email, and we will never ask for money as part of an interview process or job offer. If you receive a suspicious email about Oyster jobs or are directed to a site other than www.oysterhr.com/careers http://www.oysterhr.com/careers, please report it via our Compliance and Ethics Helpline https://faceup.com/c/8tpzyyye.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.



This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.



You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

title: VP of Sales, AMER
description:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.




WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.




MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

We're looking for a VP of Sales to lead our Americas (AMER) region. This is a second line leadership position with 5 Sales Leaders reporting into you, covering Enterprise, Mid-Market, and key verticals across North America, Latin America, and Canada.

You will own both Corporate (Mid-Market) and Enterprise segmentations across your teams, with significant opportunity to win some of the biggest logos in the Americas. Our sales team is headquartered in Austin, TX, and this role can be based in either San Francisco or Austin.

This role is about bringing operational excellence and rigor to the sales organization, driving net new logo wins, and helping our customers understand the transformative opportunity of our AI language platform — covering both written and voice translation.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Leadership & vision: Provide clear direction and inspire Enterprise Sales Leaders and their teams to achieve excellence in both new business acquisition and customer expansion across the Americas.

 - Team development: Hire, onboard, and coach Sales Leaders based in Austin and across the region, ensuring their success in managing and developing their Account Executive teams.

 - Deep enterprise expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of DeepL's products and solutions, with a strong understanding of the enterprise segment, competitive landscape, and industry trends across North America and Latin America.

 - Accountability: Own the attainment of performance metrics for Sales Leaders and their teams, driving success across the full sales funnel.

 - Collaboration: Partner with cross-functional teams—Sales Development, Solution Consultants, Customer Success, Product, and Marketing—to ensure alignment and optimize resources for the enterprise segment.

 - Pipeline management: Build, support, track, and analyze sales pipelines and team activities to identify and act on trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.

 - Forecasting & reporting: Deliver accurate, predictable sales forecasts to senior leadership, highlighting progress, obstacles, and actionable insights.

 - Process & scalability: Establish and refine scalable policies, processes, and procedures to support enterprise revenue growth effectively across the AMER region.

 - Hands-on support: Roll up your sleeves to support your team and customers, demonstrating a customer-first mindset and adaptability in a fast-moving environment.




QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR

 - Experienced sales leader: Proven success leading sales managers and their teams, ideally within an enterprise B2B SaaS sales environment in the US or broader Americas market.

 - Strong coaching & mentoring skills: Ability to identify, inspire, and coach Sales Managers, fostering their ability to lead high-performing, geographically distributed teams.

 - Sales methodology expertise: Familiarity with MEDDIC/MEDDICC or similar sales methodologies and structured sales playbooks.

 - Results-oriented: Self-directed and motivated to exceed expectations, with a passion for driving customer success and measurable revenue impact.

 - Adaptable & resilient: Thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments; comfortable managing change and ambiguity in a high-growth global company.

 - Scale-up and corporate experience: A mix of scale-up agility and corporate rigor is highly desirable, with experience scaling teams across the Americas.

 - Cross-cultural communication: Ability to operate effectively across diverse cultures and time zones, collaborating with teams in the US, Europe, and globally.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

 - Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

 - Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team's general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

 - Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that's why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL's growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

 - Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

 - Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

 - 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

 - Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

#LI-TB1




WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Pair closely with engineering and product to initiate and complete roadmap projects, no hand-offs

 - Spot opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 7+ years experience designing software

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping in Figma (and beyond with tools like AI, HTML/CSS, Origami)

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $220,000—$268,250. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

title: Ad Sales Lead - West
Senior Director, Revenue Strategy
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

You’ll join Mural’s global Revenue team as the leader of our strategy, operations, systems, and enablement functions. In this role, you will guide a high-impact team where cross-functional partnership and operational excellence are central to our growth. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, you will deliver strategic insights, streamlined processes, operational excellence, and effective enablement programs that empower our teams and drive outstanding results for our customers. We foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement—making a meaningful impact on Mural’s success.




YOUR MISSION

You will architect and lead Mural’s revenue strategy, revenue operations, GTM systems, and sales enablement functions to accelerate business performance and growth. Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer, you will serve as a strategic thought partner—proactively identifying opportunities, solving challenges, and translating company priorities into scalable revenue-driving initiatives. You will drive alignment across GTM teams, oversee operational excellence, and build enablement programs that boost seller effectiveness.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 -  Develop and execute holistic revenue strategies, unifying GTM planning, sales enablement, and operational priorities to achieve ambitious growth targets.

 - Serve as a proactive strategic partner to the CRO and GTM leadership team, helping translate vision into execution.

 - Direct and coach the Revenue Operations team, overseeing performance analysis, process optimization, and the rollout of new systems and initiatives.

 - Lead the sales enablement function, driving programs that increase seller productivity, skill growth, and customer engagement.

 - Direct and coach the GTM Systems team, overseeing system strategy, administration, optimization, and the rollout of new tools and capabilities.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to ensure strategic alignment and operational excellence.

 - Deliver executive-level reporting, business reviews, and actionable insights to CRO and senior leadership.

 - Foster a high-performing, collaborative team culture; empower direct reports to innovate, experiment, and drive measurable results.

 - Balance high-level strategic thinking with a bias for execution—rolling up your sleeves when needed to turn plans into outcomes.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 -  10+ years of experience in revenue strategy and operations, with proven ability to build and scale teams.

 - Background in SaaS or technology industries; experience with both scaling and mature organizations preferred.

 - Strong expertise in GTM strategy, revenue planning, and operational execution.

 - Track record of optimizing sales processes, implementing new systems, and improving performance.

 - Skilled in financial planning, forecasting, and analyzing sales performance metrics.

 - Effective communicator with advanced analytical, coaching, and change management abilities; adept at facilitation and driving alignment.

 - Proficient in leveraging AI-driven tools and data to inform strategy and enhance operational efficiency.

 - Results-driven, with a passion for innovation, team development, and continuous improvement.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Product Design Manager
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Design Manager to support our mission.

This role is based in New York or San Francisco and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.



About the Team

The Design team at Patreon is responsible for the full consumer experience across our creator and fan products. The team spans product design and content design, working across Patreon's core surfaces: memberships, community, live video, and direct sales. Designers here are embedded in cross-functional teams alongside product, engineering, and data, and are expected to drive outcomes, not just deliver assets.

At Patreon, design is fundamental to how we build and how we think about the product. This team reflects that: high craft standards, close partnership with product leadership, and a genuine curiosity about how AI can raise the bar for what we ship



About the Role

As Senior Staff Design Manager, you'll lead a team of 6-7 product designers alongside another senior design manager, and represent the design leadership bench at Patreon.

You'll lead by example in the craft, not just through management: staying close to the work in Figma, prototyping, or production code, while partnering across product and engineering to shape the next chapter of design at Patreon. 

You'll also be a strong external voice for the design team, helping build Patreon's reputation as a place where great designers want to work.



What you’ll need:

 - You've shipped distinctive consumer software where design was central to the product's market position, not just polish on a working thing, across a range of products or surfaces rather than a single hero project

 - You lead by example in the craft, whether in Figma, prototyping, or production code

 - You're a proven manager with success across different sizes and shapes of design teams, and you've operated across different configurations (startup, scale, public) rather than running one playbook

 - You have real AI fluency: you use tools daily and have driven measurable, team-wide transformation in velocity, quality, or scope

 - You have a track record of building and holding high talent density: top designers choose to work for you and stay, and the people you've hired and developed have gone on to become strong leaders themselves

 - You're a strategic thought partner across functions, oriented toward shared outcomes rather than territory

 - You're a strong external voice for your team's work, brand, and craft



We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t match with every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we’d love to hear from you.



About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.



Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.



Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.



Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office two days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal of this policy is to be  intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.



At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.



The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. The final offer will be based on candidate’s experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon’s leveling framework. For remote employees located outside CA and NY, salary may vary based on location and local market conditions.



Patreon reserves the right to modify or update compensation and benefits at any time.

description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $204,000—$264,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

title: Director, AI Solutions Strategy & Planning

Enterprise Account Executive
description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.




THE ROLE:

Airbyte is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing sales organization. In this role, you will own a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts and be responsible for generating, progressing, and closing new business across Airbyte’s product offerings.



You will work a mix of qualified inbound opportunities and strategically selected target accounts, while building relationships and creating demand across your territory. You will primarily engage with CTO, CIO, data, and engineering organizations, working with stakeholders ranging from data engineers and architects to senior business and technology executives.



A successful candidate will be comfortable navigating complex technical environments, leading multi-stakeholder sales processes, and connecting technical capabilities to measurable business outcomes. A foundational understanding of cloud infrastructure, the modern data stack, APIs, data integration, and database replication is strongly preferred. Candidates with a demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts will also be considered.



This is a new-business-focused role. Success will be driven by landing strategic customers, establishing Airbyte within an initial use case, and creating a clear path toward broader adoption across the organization. You will join a fast-growing company with a strong product-led motion, a highly technical customer base, and a significant market opportunity.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from account development and discovery through technical evaluation, proposal, negotiation, procurement, and closed-won.

 - Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through a combination of qualified inbound opportunities, targeted outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and strategic account development.

 - Develop trusted relationships across technical, business, and executive stakeholders within enterprise accounts.

 - Lead effective discovery to uncover customer challenges, business priorities, technical requirements, and decision criteria.

 - Apply value-selling principles and Airbyte’s sales methodology, including Command of the Message and MEDDPICC, to quantify customer pain, establish urgency, differentiate Airbyte, and maintain control of the sales process.

 - Build clear and compelling business cases that connect Airbyte’s technical capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Engineering to scope, manage, and successfully complete technical evaluations and proofs of value.

 - Navigate complex security, legal, procurement, and commercial processes.

 - Create account strategies that support both initial adoption and long-term expansion.

 - Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, MEDDPICC, and forecast information.

 - Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly bookings targets.

 - Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Engineering, Customer Success, and other internal teams to share market feedback, competitive intelligence, customer requirements, and product opportunities.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 3-5+ years of B2B sales experience within SaaS, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, or data technology, including at least 1-2+ years selling into enterprise accounts.

 - A demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding quota in a new-business sales role.

 - Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles.

 - Experience using structured enterprise sales methodologies such as Command of the Message, MEDDPICC, and value-based selling.

 - A proven ability to uncover and quantify business pain, build compelling value propositions, establish urgency, and navigate enterprise decision-making processes.

 - Confidence engaging both technical practitioners and executive buyers.

 - The ability to translate complex technical capabilities into clear business value.

 - Strong prospecting, discovery, presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.

 - Excellent organization, pipeline management, and forecasting discipline.

 - Direct experience with data infrastructure, cloud platforms, data integration, or the modern data stack is strongly preferred.

 - A proactive, curious, accountable, and collaborative working style.

 - The ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

 


LOCATION:

 - Remote in Toronto, Canada




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:

 - Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually, and public holidays in line with provincial employment standards

 - Comprehensive health coverage – extended health benefits on top of provincial public healthcare

 - Virtual healthcare – access to doctors and other care providers online, so you can get care without waiting

 - Retirement savings – a group retirement savings plan to help you build for the future

 - Statutory protections – Canada/Québec Pension Plan, Employment Insurance and workers' compensation coverage

 - Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement

 

If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!

 

We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 

 


THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a Technical Support Engineer who loves helping customers and can't leave a problem alone until it's solved.

You're an engineer who happens to do support. You pick up new things fast and you're comfortable with a problem nobody has seen before. That matters more to us than your previous job title, and people on our team came to support from various backgrounds.

You care about how a customer feels when they leave the conversation, not only whether the ticket closed. You take feedback well, say when you don't know something yet, and learn from anyone on the team.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Helping customers across all of PostHog's products, in the app and in shared Slack channels with our bigger customers

 - Owning your tickets from beginning to end, and keeping customers updated along the way

 - Shipping fixes to the PostHog codebase and docs when you find something broken or unclear

 - Becoming the support expert for a product area: owning its queue, working closely with the engineering team behind it, and spotting the patterns that turn into fixes

 - Improving how we do support, including the tooling and workflows we build on PostHog itself

 - Passing customer pain points and feature requests to engineering teams with enough context for them to prioritize


WHAT YOU WON’T BE DOING

❌ You won't be routing tickets, or forwarding hard questions to engineering because they look hard.

❌ You won't say "that's not my job". If you can't solve something, you find who can and make the connection.

❌ You also won't be pasting AI answers back to customers. We use AI every day, but we expect you to test things out for yourself and write a reply to the customer that's better than the one it would write. Here's more on how we think about that https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/stop-adding-ai-between-you-your-customers-posthog-gkxle/.




HOW WE WORK

You'll be the face of PostHog for many of our customers. Most of them are engineers, so they want help from someone who understands the technical detail and writes back like a person.

We want support to be part of why people choose PostHog.

We provide support across EU and US time zones, and we're hiring in both. We work in public by default, so you'll ask for help, share what you learn, and discuss problems in team channels rather than DMs.

Read more about how the support team works https://posthog.com/handbook/support/support-team and our company values https://posthog.com/handbook/values.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience in at least two programming languages, whether from a previous role, side projects, or something else

 - Experience debugging unfamiliar code or systems, and checking your fix works

 - Clear, concise writing that explains a complex fix without burying the customer in options

 - Thorough investigations that don't slow down your reply to the customer

 - Good at prioritizing and context switching across a busy queue that spans many products

Nice to have

 - Experience supporting similar products, e.g. analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, or LLM observability

 - A background in support, teaching, product, or another role where you explain technical things to people

We’re hiring Senior Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function in North America, focusing on Mountain, Central, and West regions. This is a Senior Solutions Engineer position, and we expect to pay between $211,197 and $257,901 OTE (on-target earnings), split 70% base / 30% variable, with the variable portion paid quarterly.

description:

We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.







THE ROLE:

Airbyte is building the runtime that powers production-grade AI agents.



This is not an ML research or prompt engineering role. We’re looking for an experienced backend or platform engineer who has built complex production systems and has also worked hands-on with AI agents, orchestration, retrieval, or LLM-powered applications.



Our AI Runtime sits between language models and the enterprise systems agents need to understand and act on. It is responsible for assembling the right context, identifying entities across systems, selecting tools and connectors, coordinating execution, validating evidence, enforcing permissions, and handling failures safely.



A user may ask something simple like:

 - “Investigate this customer and tell me what changed.”

Behind that request, the runtime may need to identify the customer across multiple systems, retrieve fresh data, determine which tools to call, coordinate multiple steps, validate the result, and return an answer with evidence the user can trust.



That infrastructure is what you’ll help build.



We’re still early. The architecture is taking shape, but there is significant room to influence how the runtime is designed, how developers interact with it, and how we make agentic systems reliable in production.






WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Build the Runtime

 - Design and implement the orchestration layer that turns natural-language intent into reliable, multi-step execution.

 - Build systems for routing, state management, retries, failure handling, and long-running agent workflows.

 - Develop systems for entity resolution, context assembly, connector orchestration, and evidence retrieval.

 - Build reusable Skills that encapsulate business workflows and domain-specific capabilities.

 - Coordinate connectors, APIs, tools, deterministic logic, retrieval systems, and multiple language models.



Build Reliable AI Infrastructure

 - Design systems that retrieve and assemble the right enterprise context at runtime.

 - Build evidence-backed reasoning with citations and traceability that users can inspect and verify.

 - Implement permission models, freshness validation, and action policies for production environments.

 - Build evaluation, replay, observability, and debugging systems that help us understand why agents succeed or fail.

 - Improve the reliability of systems where model outputs may be probabilistic, but execution cannot be.



Own Products End to End

 - Take ambiguous product ideas from prototype through production.

 - Own features across architecture, implementation, rollout, and iteration.

 - Work directly with Product, Design, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and customers to understand real-world problems.

 - Write high-leverage code that creates reusable infrastructure for future product areas.

 - Experiment with new agent architectures while maintaining production-grade reliability.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

You may be a strong fit if you are fundamentally a backend or platform engineer who has also spent meaningful time building production AI systems.

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing distributed systems.

 - Experience building complex systems involving APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency, queues, state, retries, or distributed execution.

 - Hands-on experience building production applications using LLMs, agents, RAG, tool calling, MCP, or similar technologies.

 - Experience with orchestration systems, workflow engines, developer platforms, or infrastructure products.

 - Strong system design skills and the ability to reason about reliability, scale, observability, and failure modes.

 - Ability to move quickly from prototype to production without sacrificing engineering quality.

 - Strong product instincts and comfort operating in ambiguous, 0-to-1 environments.

 - Exceptional written communication skills.

 - A strong bias toward ownership and shipping.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience building agent infrastructure, agent platforms, or evaluation systems.

 - Familiarity with orchestration technologies such as LangGraph, Temporal, MCP, or similar.

 - Experience with retrieval systems, vector search, search infrastructure, or knowledge graphs.

 - Experience building developer tools or platform infrastructure.

 - Experience with data infrastructure such as Kafka, Iceberg, Postgres, Spark, or modern data warehouses.

 - Experience working on early-stage products where you helped define architecture and technical direction.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Success is not measured by the sophistication of the prompts. It is measured by whether the runtime becomes more reliable, observable, and trustworthy over time.

You’ll build systems that:

 - Assemble the right context and choose the correct connectors, tools, and Skills.

 - Execute multi-step workflows reliably.

 - Recover gracefully when something fails.

 - Produce evidence-backed answers with citations and traceability.

 - Enforce permissions, freshness guarantees, and action policies.

 - Learn from failures through replay, evaluation, and observability.

 - Allow users to focus on outcomes rather than coordinating individual tools themselves.

As the runtime evolves, developers and users should need to think less about the underlying tools and more about what they want to accomplish. The runtime should handle the complexity underneath.






WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

AI agents work impressively in demos. Making them reliable in production is much harder.

The difficult problems are often not the model itself. They are retrieving the right context, connecting to real enterprise systems, maintaining permissions, coordinating multiple actions, recovering from failures, and determining whether an answer can actually be trusted.

Airbyte already connects to hundreds of business systems. We’re building the runtime that allows agents to use that infrastructure intelligently and safely.

If we succeed, developers will not need to rebuild orchestration, retrieval, permissions, evaluation, and enterprise connectivity every time they build a new agent.

title: Client Director - Financial Services
Senior Machine Learning Engineer (Clinical Team)
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

 1. Own the tissue-class segmentation and labeling models for the ultrasound CT clinical analysis layer, and the pipelines that make them trainable and verifiable.

 2. Retune across 2D per-slice, 3D volumetric, and 2D×3D fusion as reconstructed image inputs are continuously updated, and clinical indications for use expand.

 3. Define training/evaluation pipelines, datasets, and metrics from the ground up or from open source; map model behavior to user needs and design requirements.

 4. Work with data labeling contractors, expert clinicians, and our internal cloud/data teams on labeling specs, QC, and dataset versioning.

 5. Help productionize models into a versioned, HIPAA-bound analysis service: reproducible/low-latency inference, per-prediction confidence, drift monitoring, and safe fallbacks.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong applied ML experience with a track record of developing new models — architecting, training, and evaluating from scratch as well as benchmarking against existing models.

 - Experience with image segmentation (semantic/instance, 2D and ideally 3D/volumetric) and the modeling and training-data choices that make it robust across diverse patient anatomy.

 - Comfortable moving fluidly between open-ended research iteration and producing quantifiable, testable models.

 - Fluent in modern deep-learning tooling (e.g., PyTorch) and current development practices.

 - Comfortable working under design controls, where model changes carry documentation and verification weight.


USEFUL EXPERIENCE

 - Image segmentation and label generation with modern architectures (U-Net / nnU-Net, 3D U-Net, transformer-based and promptable segmentation like SAM), including the geometry that ties voxel- and mesh-level predictions back to a coordinate frame.

 - Learning under limited or noisy supervision: self-supervised / semi-supervised methods (masked autoencoders, contrastive pretraining like DINO/SimCLR), active learning, weak labels, and simulation-driven pretraining.

 - Hands-on experience with data curation for ML: building datasets from messy, real-world sources, helping to define ground truth, and managing labeling or simulation pipelines (MONAI, ITK / SimpleITK, 3D Slicer).

 - Experience with segmentation models for ultrasound imaging, whether on synthetic or real images

 - ML for imaging or inverse problems in physics-based domains (CT, MRI, ultrasound, or adjacent), and comfort working alongside reconstruction/signal-processing teams.

 - Deploying models in versioned, auditable, high-stakes settings.

 - A background in anatomy, medical imaging, or body composition and prior work with existing segmentation models is a plus.
