 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - How Linear uses Linear: How our Customer Experience team works in Linear https://linear.app/now/cx-in-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear



Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

title: Technical Account Manager (US)
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to own the technical success of n8n’s strategic top tier customers, helping them run healthy, scalable, and high-performing environments while maximizing long-term platform adoption.

As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll partner closely with customers and internal teams to make sure top tier accounts get the guidance, support, and operational excellence they need to succeed:

 


OWN THE TECHNICAL SUCCESS OF TOP TIER CUSTOMERS

 - Act as the dedicated technical point of contact for a portfolio of strategic top tier customers.

 - Lead the technical handoff from Sales Engineering to ensure continuity from implementation into ongoing operations.

 - Build deep relationships with technical stakeholders, architects, platform owners, and engineering leaders.
   
    


DRIVE PLATFORM HEALTH, SCALABILITY, AND PERFORMANCE

 - Continuously assess customer deployments to identify risks around scalability, reliability, performance, and maintainability.

 - Provide strategic recommendations for platform improvements, upgrades, optimizations, and architectural changes.

 - Guide customers on automation and workflow best practices when they impact platform performance, reliability, or scalability.
   
    


MANAGE ESCALATIONS AND OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

 - Oversee technical support intake, issue management, critical incidents, and high-severity support cases.

 - Coordinate cross-functional responses with Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams.

 - Keep customers informed with timely communication, clear resolution plans, and proactive risk management.
   
    


TURN CUSTOMER INSIGHTS INTO CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Analyze support activity, recurring issues, usage patterns, and operational risks to drive preventative action plans.

 - Triage technical product issues, bugs, and feature requests, ensuring feedback is accurately captured internally, and tracking through to completion with product & engineering.

 - Share structured customer insights with Product and Engineering to improve platform outcomes at scale.

 - Identify and address technical product gaps surfaced by enterprise customers, from triaging bugs and feature requests to contributing lightweight fixes, workflow improvements, or pull requests where appropriate, partnering with Product and Engineering to get high-impact improvements adopted.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 


MUST-HAVES

 - 🧭 Technical account leadership: You have strong experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, Customer Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role.

 - ☁️ Infrastructure and platform expertise: You deeply understand cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, APIs, integrations, and platform operations.

 - 🔎 Production troubleshooting: You have diagnosed performance, reliability, and scalability challenges in production environments.

 - 💬 Clear technical communication: You can translate complex technical topics into actionable recommendations for both technical and business stakeholders.

 - 🤝 Stakeholder management: You’re confident building trust with senior technical stakeholders and aligning internal teams around customer outcomes.

 - 🔁 Cross-functional collaboration: You have worked closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to solve customer challenges.

 - 🛠️ Strong DevOps and infrastructure experience, including hands-on exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, self-hosted deployments, cloud environments, and the operational considerations needed to run scalable, reliable production systems.
   
    


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🔧 At least 6 months experience with n8n or similar workflow automation / iPaaS platforms such as Zapier, Make, Node-RED or similar.

 - 🤖 Familiarity with AI / LLM integrations, agentic workflows, or automation use cases involving AI-enabled business processes.

 - 🏢 Experience supporting both self-hosted and SaaS enterprise customers, especially in complex or highly regulated environments.

 - 🧑‍💻 Background working with open-source, developer-first, or technical platform products.

 - 📈 Previous exposure to scaling customer success or TAM motions in a high-growth SaaS or infrastructure company.

 - 🤝 Proactive and consultative in approach, with the ability to understand the business impact of technical issues, anticipate upcoming challenges, and stay organised across multiple customer priorities.
   
    

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll play a key role in shaping how our most strategic customers scale their automation infrastructure with confidence. You’ll be the technical owner for long-term top tier partnerships, working closely with customers and internal teams to improve platform health, reduce operational risk, and turn real-world customer insights into better product outcomes.

You’ll join one of Europe’s fastest-growing startups at an exciting stage of growth, with the autonomy to build trusted relationships, influence how we deliver top tier support, and help define what exceptional technical success looks like for enterprise customers.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

title: Senior Investment Designer (Rewards and Commerce)
Product Designer
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.



Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.



We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Product Designer to support our mission.



This role is open to remote candidates in select U.S. locations. For those based in New York or San Francisco, we ask that you work from the office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.




ABOUT THE TEAM

We’re hiring a Product Designer to help shape the experiences that define how creators and fans connect on Patreon. You’ll work on meaningful product problems across the creator and fan journey, from how creators share and grow their work to how fans discover, engage with, and build deeper relationships with the creators they love.

You’ll tackle complex, high-impact opportunities that span the product, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and turning ideas into thoughtful, polished experiences. Your work may involve evolving core product experiences, exploring new ways for creators to showcase their work and connect with fans, or designing tools and systems that help creators build sustainable businesses and engaged communities.

title: Product Manager
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.

Most of the products we build don’t have obvious precedents. We need product managers who can help teams navigate that uncertainty, make decisions, and turn ambitious ideas into products people can actually use.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help lead that effort.

You’ll work closely with design, engineering, and research throughout the product development process, using tools like Claude Code to prototype concepts. You’ll help teams stay organized, make thoughtful decisions, and move projects from early ideation to launch.

This is a hands-on role. Some days you’ll be writing product specs, running standups, and coordinating launches. Other days you’ll be interviewing users, reviewing prototypes, or digging into product questions that need deeper investigation. If you enjoy bringing structure to creative work and making it easier for great teams to do their best work, you’ll probably enjoy it here.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the execution of major product initiatives.

 - Partner closely with design and engineering from early exploration through launch.

 - Write product requirements, manage backlogs, and keep projects moving.

 - Facilitate planning, standups, reviews, and comms between teams.

 - Help teams make informed decisions through UXR, research, and using Midjourney deeply yourself.

 - Go deep on important product questions when needed, whether that means conducting user research, designing experiments, or working through a difficult product tradeoff.

 - Help teams decide what matters most and make smart choices about quality, scope, and speed.




YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You’ve spent the last several years building software people love to use.

 - You know how to create structure without weighing a team down.

 - You’re as comfortable writing a product spec as you are talking to users or reviewing a prototype.

 - You have a point of view, but care more about getting the product right than being right.

 - Using Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.

 - You’re excited to build products that don’t come with established playbooks.

 - Work > ego




LOGISTICS

 - Full-time. SF Hybrid.

 - Compensation: $185,000-225,000 + benefits.

title: Lead Financial Analyst, Strategic Business Partner – Product & Technology
Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.

 


THE ROLE:

As Airbyte's Accounting Manager, you’ll own the day-to-day of our accounting operations and reporting - and you’ll help us rebuild how that work gets done, replacing manual processes and outsourced accounting firm dependencies with clean, automated, in-house workflows.

We currently run a lean model with an outsourced accounting firm and a Senior Accountant. You’ll manage both, and over time help us bring accounting back in-house - taking ownership of more of the function as you go. You’ll report directly to the Director of Finance (who reports to the COO) as a thought partner on automating our close and operations, and you’ll have real room to experiment with modern tooling and AI to do it.

We're hiring someone with the intention of investing in their long-term growth. As the business evolves, this role is expected to take on increasing ownership and responsibility, with the opportunity to help shape and ultimately lead the accounting function over time. If you want to build a modern accounting function - not just maintain one - this is that seat.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Own accounting operations and reporting - GL, AP/AR, and the general ledger close - with accuracy, timeliness, and US GAAP compliance; you’ll operate with high ownership and strong judgment.

 - Run the month-end close, and continuously shorten and automate it.

 - Manage a Senior Accountant and our outsourced accounting team, and help lead the transition of work in-house over time.

 - Prepare for and support external audits, including documentation, technical accounting memos, and internal controls.

 - Apply and help maintain technical accounting policies, including revenue recognition under ASC 606 and lease accounting under ASC 842.

 - Evaluate, implement, and optimize accounting systems and workflows - reducing manual work and building for scale.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Support to keep accounting accurate across our business systems.

 - Act as a thought partner to the Director of Finance on automating close and operations, including using AI where it drives real impact.

 - Grow into broader ownership of the accounting function as the business scales.

 - Perform and review detailed flux and variance analysis, identifying and proactively investigating unexpected trends or anomalies in our financials.

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 5+ years of progressive accounting experience.

 - Ideally a Big 4 audit and startup combined background.

 - Working knowledge of US GAAP, including revenue recognition (ASC 606) and lease accounting (ASC 842).

 - Strong systems instincts - you’ve evaluated, implemented, or redesigned accounting workflows and tools, and you reach for automation before manual effort.

 - Tech-savvy and genuinely AI-curious - you’ve explored (or are eager to explore) how automation and AI can transform accounting, and you like building.

 - An operational, ownership mindset - pragmatic, solution-oriented, and able to work autonomously. Startups move fast, so the ability to adapt and learn quickly is key.

 - A people person. We have a strong culture and care about bringing in teammates who fit in and make it better.

 


NICE TO HAVE:

 - CPA or CMA certification is a plus.

 - Experience implementing or migrating to a new ERP system.

 - Experience with PLG and/or enterprise SaaS revenue models.

 - Familiarity with our stack: NetSuite, Rillet, Campfire, Ramp, Carta, Orb, and Claude Code.

 - Experience with auditing.

 


LOCATION:

 - Onsite 4 days/week in San Francisco, CA




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:



• Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
 • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents
 • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
 • 401(k) retirement plan
 • Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
 • Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 •  Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office
 • A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!

description:

title: Field Marketing Manager
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the United States, with San Francisco or New York preferred. You can work from anywhere within the US. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $144,000—$179,500. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Remote US & Canada



We are seeking a highly motivated and autonomous Senior Data Analyst to join our team.

In this role, you will be pivotal in surfacing insights and providing guidance to a broad spectrum of disciplines across the studio, empowering these teams to leverage data in new ways and do their best work with accurate data in hand.

 - Be curious; a detail-oriented problem solver and a self starter who is comfortable taking risks. Know how and when to apply your knowledge, and be willing to share with the rest of us

title: Contract | Senior SDET (MARVEL SNAP)
description:
Who We Are

Second Dinner is an award-winning independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. In fact, our game MARVEL SNAP has earned multiple Mobile Game of the Year Awards (Game Awards https://www.marvel.com/articles/games/marvel-snap-mobile-game-of-the-year-2022, DICE https://www.pocketgamer.biz/news/80935/marvel-snap-wins-mobile-game-of-the-year-at-the-dice-awards/), Best Strategy Game (IGN) https://www.ign.com/articles/best-strategy-game-2022, and the Apple Design Award for Innovation https://www.gamedeveloper.com/business/marvel-snap-and-resident-evil-village-among-apple-design-award-winners!



Second Dinner is a remote-first studio, so while we are headquartered in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote across the United States. We want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. A diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company and will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside.



Our Engineering Team:

At Second Dinner, we believe that great people in a great work environment lead to great games and player experiences. In engineering, we empower our teams to build and innovate with best-in-class tools in novel ways. Our goal is to simplify game development and redefine what is possible in game development.



Your Role:

You will own and drive Marvel Snap’s Test Automation initiative, as well as perform various DevOps duties. You will report to the Lead Engineer of the Live Stability team and collaborate with QA analysts, engineers, and artists to create test suites, build pipelines, and develop tools to ensure we deliver the highest quality games possible to our players! If you’re passionate about testing, automation, validation, and continuous integration, then we'd love to hear from you!



This is a 6-month contract role to start (with possible extension), but if it's a great mutual fit, it could evolve into a full-time position.



What You’ll Do:

 - As an automation superhero, you’ll identify, design, and deliver technical solutions (frameworks, tests, API hooks, tools) that increase test effectiveness, coverage, and overall development velocity

 - Build and enhance continuous integration and delivery pipelines to support development teams across MARVEL SNAP

 - Own the long-term development and roadmap of test automation

 - Implement metrics, analyze test data to identify patterns, and report on risk status to help enhance software quality

 - Optimize testing efforts and develop new opportunities using automation that will empower the QA team to be more effective and efficient

 - Automate everything: from command lines to complex workflows, find opportunities to improve how we build and test the game, ultimately to improve the player experience

What You’ll Need:

 - Demonstrated ability designing and owning scalable automated testing solutions, including test frameworks, test infrastructure, and execution pipelines

 - Proficiency in unit and integration test frameworks in C#/.NET or other object-oriented programming language

 - Experience integrating test pipelines into CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins

 - Knowledge of industry best testing practices, including unit, integration, end-to-end, acceptance, functional, and performance testing

 - Ability to work independently, charting the course for the company in test automation

 - Passion for empowering teams with best-in-class automated testing tools, frameworks, and test harnesses to improve operations

 - An agile mindset, a desire for constant improvement of tooling, automation, and process to improve the quality of our products and the lives of our teammates

 - High levels of empathy and support for team members, both technical and non-technical

 - Passion for playing and making great games

Nice to Have, But Not Necessary:

 - Experience with test automation in Unity, such as Unity Test Runner

 - Experience with mobile, web, or game automation frameworks such as Appium, Selenium, Playwright, or GameDriver

 - Experience developing on-device automated test pipelines for either physical hardware devices or using platforms such as AWS Device Farm or Kobiton

 - Experience with test case management systems such as TestRail or qTest



This position pays a range of $72-82 per hour (USD).

Individual pay within this range may span multiple levels within the discipline and is determined by assessed job-related skills, experience, relevant education, or training. It also factors in market demands and business needs. The disclosed range is not adjusted based on location and may be subject to change or modification based on business needs in the future. title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
Performance Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we're changing how teams collaborate, think, and make decisions together. Growth Marketing sits inside Product and owns how people discover Mural and decide to start. Paid is a core acquisition engine for the business, working across both our self-serve and sales-assisted motions. You will own it end to end and work closely with partners across Product, Marketing, and Sales to turn demand into teams that rely on Mural.




YOUR MISSION

You will own Mural's paid marketing end to end: the channels, the budget, and the results. Paid plays a role across the full funnel and supports the different ways Mural grows, from building early awareness to reaching people when they are ready to act. You will bring these efforts together into one connected program, lean on experimentation and measurement to learn what works, and help turn marketing investment into durable growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own strategy, budget, execution, and reporting for paid across search, paid social, and video and display, running it as one connected program across the full funnel.

 - You will own Mural’s paid marketing end to end, with a focus on generating efficient growth across self-serve acquisition and sales-assisted demand. Success will be measured by the quality and volume of activated users, qualified pipeline, and revenue generated from paid investment.

 - Build and run a continuous experimentation program across audiences, creative, landing pages, and offers.

 - Lead agency and vendor partners to execute and scale the program.

 - Partner with our Data team on attribution and measurement to connect paid spend to real outcomes.

 - Partner across Marketing and Web on messaging and the post-click experience.

 - Set performance targets and expand the program into new regions and languages, including EMEA and APAC.

 - Support account-based and demand generation programs in close partnership with the Sales and RevOps teams.

 - Use AI in your daily workflow to move faster across keyword, creative, analysis, and reporting work, with a point of view on where AI is changing paid marketing. 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of hands-on B2B digital and performance marketing, owning paid search, paid social, and video or display with real budget responsibility.

 - A full funnel operator comfortable across both self-serve growth and sales-assisted demand. You have owned awareness and demand creation, not only bottom funnel capture, and can show how top of funnel and account-based work pay off downstream.

 - You design and read clean tests across audiences, creative, and landing pages, and you know what to do with an inconclusive result.

 - Comfort living in the performance data, with hands-on fluency in SQL, product analytics, and BI tools.

 - A real point of view on measurement. You know where last-click falls short and have used holdouts, incrementally, or media mix testing to judge channels that do not attribute cleanly.

 - Experience running paid inside a self-serve or freemium model, with a feel for how acquisition connects to activation and retention.

 - A self-starter who is motivated and scrappy, thinks through problems, and brings innovative solutions in a high-growth environment. 


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Strategic Account Executive, LATAM (Spanish)
Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. 

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. 

 

The role:  

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

 

What you'll do: 

 - Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

 - Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

 - Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

 - Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

 - Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

 - Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

 - Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

 - Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

 - Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

 - Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

 - Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability
   
    

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

 - Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

 - Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

 - Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

 

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

 

Our Paddle hubs:

 - In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

 - In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

 - In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

 

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: AI Deployment Manager (APAC)
description:
We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

 - Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

 - Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

 - Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.


ABOUT THE TEAM

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. Our primary objective is to elevate the onboarding experience by delivering a white-glove service and expert guidance to our customers. This involves cultivating a heightened proficiency in product knowledge, engaging in consultative conversations, and adopting a strategic implementation approach that extends beyond mere activation. Our mission is to empower companies to launch swiftly and effectively on Gorgias, showcasing the exceptional value of our flagship products: Helpdesk and AI Agent.

Our team plays a pivotal role in the overall success of our products, influencing customer adoption, usage, and retention. As AI becomes central to how merchants support their customers, we're at the forefront of helping businesses unlock automation, configure AI Agent, and drive measurable outcomes from day one. By fostering meaningful connections with our customers, we contribute to the sustained growth and satisfaction of businesses leveraging Gorgias solutions.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As the AI Deployment Manager, your role is to manage the entire onboarding process for your book of business, beginning to end - from sales handover through configuration, training, and activation. As the first point of contact, this role is instrumental in managing all aspects of customer relations post-sales stage.

You will actively contribute to our mission of providing a white-glove onboarding experience, showcasing the value of our flagship products, Helpdesk and AI Agent. The perfect fit for this role is an adept professional with a consultative mindset and a strategic approach to onboarding.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Conduct in-depth implementation and optimization sessions for new and cross sold customers, tailoring the experience to drive adoption and usage of our Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

 - Build on behalf of the customer, utilizing a consultative approach to customize solutions that align with their specific needs and goals.

 - Drive the activation ratio and reduce time to activation through a white-glove experience, providing guidance and onboarding for Helpdesk and AI Agent products.

 - Establish trust with customers by demonstrating expert knowledge of our products, sharing best practices, and driving value-driven adoption to achieve key business results.

 - Act as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring seamless communication and support throughout the onboarding process.

 - Document customer interactions and feedback meticulously, leveraging this data to continuously improve the onboarding and overall customer experience.

 - Analyze and interpret e-commerce customer data, providing valuable insights to optimize support strategies using the AI Agent product.

 - Drive project timelines through clear milestone setting with the customer, ensuring effective project management throughout the onboarding process.

 - Proactively identify and mitigate potential roadblocks to decrease time to value, assisting companies in launching quickly and effectively on Gorgias.

 - Partner with sales in the pre-sales stage: run tailored demos of Helpdesk and AI Agent mapped to the merchant's support workflows, and configure sandbox environments that demonstrate real-world use cases.

 - Own proof-of-concept engagements for strategic and enterprise prospects, defining success criteria up front and driving them to a clear go/no-go decision.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience: 2-3+ years in SaaS as an implementation manager driving post-sales adoption and activation, demonstrating a successful track record. E-commerce experience is a plus!

 - Consultancy and Project Management: 2-3+ years of experience crafting and overseeing project timelines tailored to enhance activation among merchants, encompassing strategic recommendations and actionable suggestions.

 - Communication Skills: Excellent communication, interpersonal, follow-up, and attention to detail skills.

 - Proactive Work Approach: Proficient in concurrently managing up to 30 accounts at a given time, adept at tailoring support to meet the diverse needs of both small and large merchants. You are a self-starter; you will be provided with a lot of autonomy in this role.

 - Adaptability and Learning Agility: Thrives in an evolving onboarding process, demonstrating adaptability to change, quick learning, and the ability to keep up with new product developments and process changes.

 - Relationship Building: Passionate about building and maintaining relationships, with a focus on driving engagement, product adoption and mitigating churn.

 - Pre-sales instincts: comfortable stepping into sales conversations to run discovery and demos, and able to translate a merchant's pain points into a concrete solution design on the spot.

 - Passion for Learning: Demonstrated passion for continuous learning and personal growth.

 - AI & Automation Mindset: Passionate about technology, automation, and the future of AI in customer support. Comfortable configuring AI tools, discussing automation strategy with merchants, and learning new AI capabilities quickly.

AI at Gorgias
At Gorgias, AI is a natural extension of how we work and build. Our teams use it every day to research, write, analyze, code, and craft better customer experiences. Everyone has access to premium AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Granola & others) and an annual L&D budget to explore new ones.

The real magic happens when we share what we learn. Our #powerup Slack channel is a digital petri dish of new tools and workflows, and each team has AI champions who showcase fresh ideas during weekly company-wide standups, now practically AI demo sessions.

We see AI not as a replacement for creativity or empathy, but as a multiplier, helping us move faster, think deeper, and serve customers better.

AI use in Recruiting at Gorgias
By submitting your application, you agree that Gorgias may collect and process your personal data for recruiting, workforce planning, and related purposes. For more information about how we process your data and your rights, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Policy https://www.gorgias.com/legal/applicant-privacy-policy.

Diversity & Inclusion at Gorgias
We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives because diverse teams drive innovation and better decision-making.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact us at accommodation@gorgias.com.

title: Sr. Motion Designer
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Job Posted: October 2026

Location: EMEA

We're looking for a Motion Designer to join Brand Studio, the creative team behind how Zapier shows up in the world. Brand Studio is a small, high-ownership team embedded in Marketing, working at the intersection of brand, product, and enterprise positioning. We care deeply about craft, think strategically about systems, and move fast when the moment calls for it.

In this role you'll work closely with a team of brand designers and design ops, collaborate cross-functionally with PMM, Product Design, Web, and Social, and partner with external agencies on bigger productions. You'll help define how Zapier moves across every surface, and build the systems and tooling that let the whole org ship motion work independently without Brand Studio in the room every time.If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/



About You

 - You can take a UI frame or a brand brief and turn it into a story that lands. You ask the right questions, understand the product well enough to know what the animation needs to communicate, and don't wait for a fully baked storyboard to get started

 - You think in systems. You build mogrts files, component libraries, and motion guidelines that other people can use independently, and every project is an opportunity to make the next one ship faster

 - You understand brand as well as UI: timing, easing, personality, the emotional register that makes motion feel ownable rather than generic

 - You have a strong sense of sound and rhythm. You know how motion and sound work together, and you shape that relationship intentionally rather than as an afterthought

 - You understand narrative. You think about motion the way a director thinks about a scene: setup, tension, resolution. You know when to breathe and when to accelerate, and you can articulate that thinking to stakeholders

 - You manage up with creative insight, bringing your expertise into conversations proactively so stakeholders understand the why behind every creative choice

 - You use AI as a genuine part of your practice, experimenting with video tools and sharing what you figure out so the whole team benefits

 - You're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions
   
   

Things You’ll Do:

 - Design and produce motion across product explainers, website animations, paid social video snippets, keynote and event motion, and campaign assets

 - Draft simple storyboards yourself for straightforward projects so we can move fast without a separate brief-to-board cycle

 - Work directly from UI frames provided by the product team to build polished product demo animations and feature explainers

 - Build Zapier's motion design language: ownable branded motion patterns that establish how Zapier feels in motion across every surface

 - Create motion guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files that give partners and social teams repeatable building blocks to work from independently

 - Explore tools like Jitter and Figma Motion to enable partners to generate on-brand animated assets without Brand Studio involvement every time

 - Produce short video snippets for paid social testing across multiple angles and formats

 - Support the recurring product video format and turn it into a scalable template for future launches




HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. title: Accounting Manager
description:
We're looking for an Accounting Manager to take ownership of Lemonade's parent company accounting operations and help drive greater efficiency, accuracy, and transparency across our financial ecosystem. You'll sit within our Finance team, leading the month-end close process, managing a broad range of financial schedules, and acting as a key partner to our Controller and Director of Technical Accounting on SEC reporting and audit deliverables. This is a high-ownership role that touches nearly every corner of the business — from intercompany transactions to share-based compensation to lease accounting.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.




IN THIS ROLE YOU'LL

 - Lead the month-end close process for Lemonade Inc., Agency, and Life Agency — including P&L analytics, vendor breakdown reviews, and detailed expense reviews across entities

 - Manage all parent company accrual schedules, including contract and vendor accruals, professional and legal fee schedules, and underwriting expenses

 - Own share-based compensation accounting in partnership with Fidelity — preparing entries for all subsidiaries, footnote disclosures, and recording of stock option exercises

 - Oversee intercompany relationships, settlement of transactions, translation true-ups, and cost-plus relationship recording

 - Manage ASC 842 lease schedules in Trullion, prepare monthly entries, and support lease disclosure preparation

 - Lead the organization and delivery of year-end and quarterly audit procedures, and support annual SOX testing

 - Support the Controller and Director of Technical Accounting in quarterly SEC financial reporting — including financial reporting packages, footnote and disclosure preparation, and audit review support

 - Act as Finance-level AP approver for the vast majority of invoices, ensuring accuracy and appropriate tagging before escalation to cost center managers

 - Run monthly allocations, prepare allocation review schedules, reperform occupancy calculations, and support monthly GAAP ULAE entries

 - Partner cross-functionally with Business Development, Offline Media, Production, and Growth Development on financial operations including invoices, accruals, and processing


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 5+ years of experience in public or private accounting, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-entity close processes

 - Strong command of U.S. GAAP, including working knowledge of ASC 842, share-based compensation, intercompany accounting, and SEC reporting requirements

 - Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills

 - Experience with Workday ERP is a plus

 - Comfortable operating across multiple entities and legal structures simultaneously

 - Sharp attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines without dropping the ball

 - A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

 - Ability to work in our Soho, NYC office 3 days per week

 

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $125,000 - $137,500 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

title: Product Experience Team Lead
description:
TL;DR

We're growing the PX function in our Boston office and we're looking for a Team Lead to take it forward. You'll lead and develop a team of full-time PX specialists and part-time student specialists, build the AI-powered systems that let support scale faster than headcount, and be the escalation point that makes sure every user in the Americas gets the same experience our Stockholm team delivers. This role is for someone who gets energy from developing people and building the systems that let a team scale well.



Why Lovable?

Lovable lets anyone and everyone build software with any language. From solopreneurs to Fortune 100 teams, millions of people use Lovable to transform raw ideas into real products — fast. We are at the forefront of a foundational shift in software creation, which means you have an unprecedented opportunity to change the way the digital world works. Over 2 million people in 200+ countries already use Lovable to launch businesses, automate work, and bring their ideas to life. And we're just getting started.

We're a small, talent-dense team building a generation-defining company from Stockholm. We value extreme ownership, high velocity and low-ego collaboration. We seek out people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.



What we're looking for

 - Customer-obsessed: 3+ years in B2C/B2B support or a customer-facing role. You know what great user experience looks like and you hold the bar high.

 - A people developer: You've led or coached a team and you can point to people who got measurably better because of you. You give direct feedback, you run useful 1:1s, and you know the difference between managing output and growing someone's capability.

 - Operationally rigorous: You build systems, not just teams. You default to process, schedules, and metrics. You've run something where the quality of the output depended on your ability to keep a complex operation running smoothly.

 - Product & technical fluency: You understand how products work and can engage confidently with product and engineering on complex user issues. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not intimidated by technical conversations, you've used AI tools to actually change how work gets done (not just experimented), and you get up to speed on products quickly.

 - Sharp communicator: Warm, clear, and precise — whether coaching a new hire, running a feedback session, or aligning with Stockholm on a tricky escalation.

 - Based in Boston or willing to relocate — this is an in-office role.



What you'll do

 - Lead the Boston PX team: Set the culture, own day-to-day quality, and grow a team that delivers world-class PX across US time zones.

 - Develop your people: Onboard, coach, and performance-manage a mixed team of full-time PX specialists and part-time student specialists. Build the career paths that make PX a place people grow, not pass through.

 - Build agentic support infrastructure: Help improve existing and build new AI-powered systems that resolve issues, surface product signals, and scale coverage without scaling headcount 1:1.

 - Scale the operation: Own staffing, scheduling, and coverage as the team grows, and build the quality systems — QA, playbooks, enablement — that keep the bar high as headcount increases.

 - Own US escalations: Be the escalation point for complex user issues during Americas hours. Triage technical problems, collaborate with engineering when needed, and close the loop with the customer.

 - Be the voice of the user: Capture high-signal feedback from customers and make sure it reaches product and engineering.

 - Keep the student pipeline flowing: Maintain relationships with Boston-area universities to bring part-time talent into the team.

 - Collaborate globally: Work hand-in-hand with the Stockholm PX team and engineering to ensure consistent quality and shared learnings across hubs.



What success looks like

 - The team is growing without quality slipping — response quality and user satisfaction in US hours are on par with or better than our Stockholm baseline.

 - A meaningful share of volume is resolved by AI-powered systems you helped build, and the team's capacity grows faster than its headcount.

 - Your team members are visibly getting better: ramp time is shortening, and people are taking on scope beyond what they were hired for.

 - The operation runs on systems rather than heroics — coverage, QA, and onboarding work whether or not you're in the room.

 - You're seen as the connective tissue between Boston, Stockholm, and our users.



About your application

Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally — if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.



The Role:  

We are looking for a resourceful, ambitious, and autonomous sales specialist, preferably with a strong understanding of SaaS or Payments, eager to contribute to ambitious growth plans in the Americas. This is an exciting time for you to join: based on the size and breadth of our customers, we are growing like never before!

As a key member of our Sales team, your primary focus will be to convert qualified leads into delighted Paddle customers. You'll engage directly with a diverse range of companies, from SaaS to AI to app companies to established businesses within these landscapes, as they explore their e-commerce provider needs. Your role is critical in helping us define, drive, and achieve our revenue targets, ultimately bringing us closer to our vision of making Paddle the go-to solution for SaaS, AI, and app businesses worldwide.

This is a remote role based in San Francisco, CA.



What you'll do: 

 - Build pipeline from leads armed by your Business Development Representative and Marketing counterparts, as well as your own self-sourced opportunities’

 - You will be responsible for creating a portion of your own self generated pipeline opportunities

 - Be responsible for the full sales cycle from prospecting, qualifying, carrying out demo’s through to closing deals

 - Master Paddle’s product, know the features inside and out, understand the industry and be able to articulate Paddle’s value to CTO’s, Heads of Product and CEO’s alike.

 - Work with management and across departments (Marketing, Product, Success, etc.) to determine the most effective approach for each sales opportunity.

 - Identify flaws in both Paddle's and our competitors' product during the sales process, helping to inform our sales techniques and product roadmap.

 - Learn and refine new sales skills with regular Account Executive sales training sessions and continuously learn and develop yourself as a thought leader in the industry.

 - Mentor new Account Executives as they ramp and learn the process



We'd love to hear from you:

 - Have extensive closing experience in a software or SaaS business, managing multi-threaded sales processes and enterprise deals

 - Have experience with consultative, value-based selling and a proven track record of exceeding your quota

 - Have experience selling highly technical products/services 

 - Are great at liaising with prospective clients in person, over the phone and email. 

 - Have an entrepreneurial attitude which thrives when solving complex challenges and you want to be part of an exceptionally fast-growing company



It'd be great if…

 - You have experience in the payments space or selling B2B SaaS.

 - Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company.

 - Experience selling to technical persons, (CTO, Head of Product, (Technical) Founders).

 - You’re familiar with eCommerce providers such as Stripe, Braintree, PayPal, Cleverbridge and subscription based services such as Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly.

 - Able to operate in an unstructured, self-starting environment.



Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

 - Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

 - Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

 - Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

 - In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

 - In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work. 

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

description:

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.



The Role

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function in North America. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building while scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across North America.

What You’ll Do

 - Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

 - Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

 - Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia’s platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

 - Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

 - Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

 - Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

 - Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

 - Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

 - Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

 - Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

 - 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

 - Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

 - Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer’s use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

 - Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

 - Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

 - Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

 - Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

 - Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

 - Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

 - You like staying ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

 - Strong written and spoken communication in English.

We’d be particularly excited if

 - You have previous experience as an AE.

 - You have experience with video AI.

Location

We're looking for someone based in Austin for this role, who can commit to 2+ days a week in-office. 

Compensation

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers across a range of experience levels and expect to pay between $155,621 and $211,197 OTE (on-target earnings), split 70% base / 30% variable, with the variable portion paid quarterly.

 - Build and implement new compliance processes from scratch — structured, efficient, and built to scale

 - Develop policies and procedures that streamline operations and keep pace with regulatory requirements across all P&C lines

 - Provide compliance guidance, coaching, and feedback to key leadership as Lemonade continues to grow across Car, Home, Renters, and Pet products

 - Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Insurance Operations, and Product, and with colleagues across the broader business

 - Drive continuous improvement through AI and automation, finding smarter ways to manage compliance at scale

 - Manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines without letting standards or attention to detail slip

 - 4+ years of P&C personal lines insurance compliance or risk management experience

 - Demonstrated persuasive writing skills — able to communicate issues clearly and translate technical and insurance requirements for different audiences

 - Strong organizational skills, with comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - Working knowledge of risk management principles across any line of business

title: Account Executive - Federal
Analytics Engineer
description:
TL;DR - We’re seeking an Analytics Engineer to own the data foundations that fuel the GTM teams: building reliable models, shaping metrics, powering automation, and turning raw data into the insights and data products that drive Sales and Customer Success.




WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for an Analytics Engineer with a background in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering who operates as a true full-stack analyst, owning everything from raw data to insights to operationalization.

You bring:

 - Strong SQL and analytical data modeling skills (ideally dbt or SQLMesh).

 - Experience with ELT/ETL workflows and cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks).

 - Comfort with Python for automation and light data engineering.

 - Experience with dashboards, BI tools, and self-serve analytics.

 - Clear communication, collaboration, and comfort working in ambiguity.

 - Nice to have: experience with AI/LLM products, instrumentation, experimentation, or early-stage startups.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner with Sales and CS on data and reporting needs. Translate ambiguous business questions into structured data models, analysis and actionable insights, and data-fueled products.

 - Build and maintain data warehouse models that serve as the source of truth for product usage and GTM metrics.

 - Model CRM data, usage data, and billing data to power Sales and CS automation, CRM enrichment, lead definition and creation, and GTM tooling.

 - Design metrics, dashboards, and data UIs in Hex and Lovable for GTM leadership and teams to access and operationalize data.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on event instrumentation and schema design.

 - Improve documentation, observability, governance, and data best practices.

 - Contribute to forecasting models, KPI definitions, and experimentation frameworks.

 - Own and improve data pipelines, ingestion workflows, and data quality testing.


YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Enjoy building clean, reliable, reusable data models.

 - Have experience partnering closely with cross-functional GTM teams to solve real problems with data.

 - Prefer simplicity over complexity in data and tooling design.

 - Communicate clearly and proactively with technical and non-technical teams.

 - Take ownership, move quickly, and iterate often.

 - Want to help define and scale Lovable’s data foundations and culture.

 - Care about the rep experience and view analytics as a product.


HOW WE HIRE

 1. Fill in a short form then jump on an initial exploratory call.

 2. Discuss your experience in more depth during a round of interviews with us.


ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

 - Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

 - We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

title: Applied AI Value Consultant
Software Engineer, Backend
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.

Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to support our mission.

This role is based in New York or San Francisco and open to those who are able to be in-office 3 days per week on a hybrid work model.

About the Team

Our team builds the insights and analytics experiences creators rely on to understand and grow their business on Patreon, along with the infrastructure that keeps those numbers accurate and trustworthy. We partner closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Design to turn creator and fan data into features creators use every day.

About the Role

As a Backend Engineer on the team, you will build and own the services, APIs, and data flows behind creator insights. You will bring a strong backend foundation and the curiosity to work in the data layer: designing data models, building and maintaining pipelines and jobs, and making sure the data creators see is correct, fast, and reliable. You will work across the stack from ingestion to the product surface, and take on work that today depends heavily on Data Engineering.

In this role you will:

 - Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs that serve creator insights at scale.

 - Build and maintain data pipelines, jobs, and models that feed insights features, in partnership with Data Engineering.

 - Improve data quality, monitoring, and performance so creators can trust what they see.

 - Collaborate with product managers, designers, data scientists, and engineers to turn ambiguous questions into well-scoped solutions.

 - Drive technical design, write well-tested and maintainable code, and mentor teammates.

What you’ll need: 

 - 3+ years or 5+ years of experience in backend software development, building production services and APIs.

 - Strong programming skills in Python or a similar language, with good engineering practices (testing, CI/CD, monitoring).

 - Strong SQL skills and experience designing and optimizing relational data models (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL).
