title: Motion Designer, Paid Social (Contract)
description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).



Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage.

This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them.

If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you.



Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok.

 - Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion.

 - Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage.

 - Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing.

 - Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed.

 - Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board.

 - Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance.

 - Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work.

 - Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts.

 - A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks.

 - Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality.

 - A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked.

 - Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand.

 - Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly.

 - Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets.

 - Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster.

 - A love of music and an eye for culture.




COMPENSATION

This is a contract role paying $70 to $90 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week.




ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is growing fast, and paid social creative is a major driver of that growth. The right person for this role takes Suno's brand identity and pushes it into performance creative that earns attention and converts – work that drives growth and brings the excitement of using Suno to everyone who sees it.

As Graphic Designer on the Performance Marketing team, you'll own the branded paid social creative pipeline: conceiving, producing, and iterating on work across branded static formats. You'll work closely with the performance marketing team, treating data and channel insights as creative inputs rather than afterthoughts. Over time, you'll help build the workflows and systems that let us scale without losing what makes Suno's creative distinctive. As the team grows, there's a path to managing other creative contributors.

 

Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Translate Suno's brand identity and creative DNA into paid social creative that drives growth across paid channels (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.)

 - Own the full branded creative pipeline – concepting, producing, and iterating on branded static assets

 - Build and maintain a creative roadmap: what to make, what to test, what to push further, and what to move on from

 - Partner with the performance marketing team to use data and channel feedback as creative inputs, not just outputs

 - Use AI tools to extend creative output beyond what's manually possible – and help build the processes and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on-brand and up to Suno's standards

 - Develop workflows and production processes that scale creative output without diluting brand quality

 - Help shape how the next generation of creators discovers Suno – the creative you make is often their first impression




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 4-6 years in performance creative, paid social design, or growth-focused creative at a consumer tech, DTC, or growth-stage company

 - Expert graphic design skills: strong static design fundamentals and a sharp eye for details and consumer psychology

 - Portfolio of paid social work that demonstrates both craft and a performance orientation

 - Expert-level proficiency in Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, etc.

 - Fluency in what makes paid social creative work: hooks, formats, platform conventions, and what drives meaningful iteration

 - Ability to internalize a brand's visual identity and push it into new formats without losing what makes it distinctive

 


COMPENSATION

$75 - $90 per hour

20-40 hours per week

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 


ABOUT ZAPIER

We’re on a mission to make automation work for everyone.

As the leader in easy automation, Zapier empowers businesses to automate workflows and move data across 7,000+ apps. We work with what you work with, across your apps and tech stack, so you can make magic happen.

We’re at an interesting inflection point at Zapier. Automation and AI are reshaping how businesses operate, and we’re right in the middle of it. We’re looking for someone who wants to help drive that innovation, not just someone who wants to hit a number.

The role: you’ll be selling Zapier’s AI Orchestration platform to companies with up to 1,000 employees, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.

Most of your pipeline will come from you. Cold outreach, turning a warm signal into a real conversation, finding the deal before it finds you, that's the job, and we need people who are built for that part, not just willing to do it.

Zapier's Mid-Market motion is early. We need architects, not order-takers. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll help write it

There's more than one path to this role

Likely you’ve been a top performer in SaaS sales (or consistently exceeding in mid-market, and you’re ready to step up) and can run a deal end-to-end, including prospecting. However, if you have a track record of tackling hard problems, hands-on experience with AI tools (not just familiarity), put customers first, and have a drive to make things happen you may also be a great fit for our team.

Either way, what separates a good candidate from a great one is proactive ownership, the ability to navigate ambiguity, strong stakeholder communication, cross-functional collaboration, and a genuine hunger to learn fast.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - You have 2-5 years of demonstrated success in selling horizontal SaaS solutions to multi-stakeholder or technical organizations across the mid-market levels, with a strong focus on automation, integrations, and enhancing tech stack efficiency.

 - Proven track record of success in closing software deals over and meeting or exceeding your sales quota

 - Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and tools like Zapier, with the ability to explain their importance in modern tech ecosystems.

 - Demonstrated ability to discuss IT concerns, including security, scalability, compliance, and performance, in a credible and knowledgeable manner.

 - Excellent communication skills both with customers and within an organization

 - Ability to develop and navigate senior-level relationships quickly and effectively

 - You thrive in a state of ambiguity and are motivated by strong personal drive

 - You use AI in your work today, not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience while intentionally  applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

AI Fluency Assessment https://ai-fluency-hub.vercel.app/

 - Take our 10 minute AI Fluency Assessment by clicking the link above. See how your skills stack up against our sales bar, get a personalized tier, and walk away with actionable next steps to level up your AI skills.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own mid-market accounts end-to-end: prospecting, discovery, negotiation, close, and expansion

 - Sell Zapier’s AI-powered automation platform to enterprises moving from manual workflows to orchestrated, AI-first operations

 - Show up in the field: build relationships at events, conferences, and executive briefings that go deeper than a LinkedIn connection

 - Build relationships across the org from the people doing the work up to the C-suite

 - Lead conversations that help customers think through the real business impact of automation, not just the product features

 - Quarterback complex deals across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product. You’re accountable for the outcome, not just your piece

 - Help shape how we go to market at the mid-market level; the team is small, fast, and building the motion from scratch


WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

This section exists to save everyone time.

 - You’re coming from a large enterprise org and need a defined territory, established SDR/BDR support, and fully built enablement to be successful

 - You measure success by activity volume over deal quality

 - You want to avoid ambiguity and prefer a structured, repeatable process handed to you

 - You can demo a product’s features, but can’t frame the ROI or build a business case from a customer’s pain

 - AI is something you’ll “get around to” rather than something you’re already using


WHY JOIN NOW

Zapier is profitable, has been around long enough to know what we’re doing, and is growing into a bigger opportunity in AI and automation. You’ll do real work where your contributions are visible and your impact is measurable. Our team is deeply curious and always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers' needs.

If breaking into AI is something you’re thinking about, there are very few companies where you’ll build with it the way you will here. We’ll take you from capable to transformative—and that’s increasingly a career-defining skill set.

We are a remote-first company. We believe the people who win in AI and automation aren’t just product experts; they synthesize information, build business cases, and move faster than the competition.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

title: UI Technical Designer
description:
UI Technical Designer

Remote - US

At thatgamecompany, we strive to create beautiful and intuitive UI, which embraces and contributes to the emotional experiences of our games. Our company is known for having a distinct perspective on what games can be, and crafting unique experiences that players can’t find elsewhere as a result; our approach to UI is no different. Our mission is to take risks in our designs, to break new ground with solutions that players haven’t seen before, and are hand-tailored towards the unique goals of our games.

We are looking for a talented UI Technical Designer to join our UI team. This individual will collaborate with the rest of our UI team, along with art, design, and engineering teams to craft attractive, minimal interfaces. The ideal candidate will have exceptional UI art and design skills, with a passion for developing new interfaces from scratch, along with doing polish passes on pre-existing interfaces and wireframes. They should be confident in contributing in all disciplines required to execute on a UI design– from creating wireframes, to designing highly polished mockups, to implementing the final product in code.



Responsibilities:

 - Work closely with the rest of the UI team to develop intuitive, beautiful, innovative interfaces for our games

 - Conceptualize new interfaces to solve design problems, and make new features possible

 - Create wireframes, mockups, and animations to drive development

 - Do polish passes on pre-existing interfaces and wireframes, to ensure the UI is up to our aesthetic and usability standards game-wide

 - Create quick-and-dirty prototypes, perform UX tests to validate our hypotheses, and iterate based on the results

 - Implement the final interface in C++ to be pixel-perfect

 - Collaborate with team members across various disciplines, and be a general advocate for usability and UI consistency



Must-Haves:

 - 3-5+ years of professional UI Design and engineering experience

 - Strong Graphic Design skills (excellent eye for typography, color usage, etc.)

 - Ability to work in a clean, minimal aesthetic

 - Experience working with Style Guides, and iterating based on art direction

 - Proficiency in C#, C++, or C for quickly prototyping interfaces

 - Experienced in industry-standard programs (ie. Illustrator, Photoshop)

 - Be a self-starter, capable of wearing many hats, and ensuring projects meet their deadlines

 - Understanding of, and ability to communicate, the user-centered design process



Nice to Haves:

 - Illustration skills

 - Experience developing multi-platform interfaces, with varying input methods (ie. touch vs. gamepad input)

 - Experience with UI design/prototyping tools such as Figma

 - Experience with motion design and animation (After Effects, etc.)

 - Understanding of HTML Flexbox layout system

 - Degree in Graphic Design, UI/UX, Fine Arts, or related field

We look forward to meeting you!

• Discount portal for everyday goods and services

• Employee inclusive and diversity initiatives such as Grow Together

• Support for personal professional development

title: Customer Support Developer (Databases)
description:
ABOUT AIRBYTE:

We’re on a mission to make data available and actionable to everyone, everywhere. With 700+ connectors, our platform powers analytics and gives AI agents the business context they need to do real work. More than 25,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Airbyte to put their data to work.


We’re built on open source because we believe companies should have full control over their data. A community of 27K members helps shape what we build, and we’re backed by $181M from investors including Benchmark, Accel, Altimeter, Coatue, and Y Combinator.


Models keep getting better. What holds AI back is the data informing and shaping its decisions, and that's the layer we're building.


We’re just getting started. If you’re excited by big challenges, meaningful ownership, and the chance to help build what’s next, we’d love to meet you.




THE ROLE:

Are you the kind of developer who gets a rush from cracking a gnarly replication bug, an issue with CDC implementation, or a query that hangs with no obvious reason? Do you thrive at the intersection of writing code and helping customers succeed? As a Customer Support Developer (Databases) at Airbyte, you'll combine hands-on development skills with deep technical empathy to support our growing cloud, embedded, and open-source integration platform. 



This isn't a traditional support role. You'll be writing Java and Kotlin, shipping contributions to our open-source database source and destination connectors, digging into query plans and transaction logs, and directly shaping how customers move mission-critical data between databases, warehouses, and lakes. You'll champion the customer voice alongside our engineering and product teams every day, getting your hands dirty in the code.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Support & Technical Troubleshooting

 - Serve as the primary technical escalation point for database-related customer issues, responding via email, ticketing systems, and video calls with precision and clarity.

 - Triage and prioritize incoming issues with urgency, consistently meeting SLA targets while leveraging AI tools to work smarter and resolve issues faster.

 - Dig into complex issues across relational databases, data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud object storage, not just finding workarounds but partnering with Engineering to root-cause and drive real fixes.

 - Reproduce customer-reported bugs by inspecting connector logs, query plans, replication slots, transaction logs, sync state, and destination table state, and document findings with enough technical detail for Engineering to act on immediately.

 - Support customers through onboarding and troubleshooting for SSH tunnels, network configuration, database user permissions, CDC setup (WAL/binlog/redo logs), and warehouse/lake authentication.



Database Connector Development

 - Get hands-on with customers building and debugging integrations, helping them navigate Airbyte's database sources and destinations with confidence, from authentication and SSL/SSH setup to CDC, schema evolution, incremental cursors, and typed destination tables.

 - Validate database version compatibility across supported engines and releases, maintain testing environments, and reproduce customer-reported behavior on real database and warehouse instances.

 - Support customers writing to data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), data lakes and object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob, Databricks, Iceberg), and databases (Postgres, MySQL, MSSQL, ClickHouse), including schema evolution and typed-columns behavior.

 - Help customers running database sources (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and more) troubleshoot replication behavior, cursor selection, full-refresh vs. incremental vs. CDC trade-offs, and sync state recovery.

 - Contribute directly to Airbyte's open-source database connectors and the Java/Kotlin Bulk CDK: fix bugs, improve error handling, harden schema-evolution and CDC paths, and submit pull requests to the Airbyte repository.

 - Review and test community contributions to database sources and destinations, helping external contributors land high-quality changes.

 - Stay sharp on Airbyte's connector catalog, new database and destination releases, and platform updates so your guidance is always accurate and timely.



Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement

 - Be the voice of the customer within Airbyte, working closely with Engineering and Product to surface issues, advocate for feature requests, and ensure customer pain points actually influence the database reliability and performance roadmap.

 - Partner with Solutions Engineering and Sales Engineering to provide white-glove technical onboarding for enterprise customers, including CDC architecture reviews, destination schema modeling, and production readiness assessments.

 - Train and mentor Technical Support Engineers on database connector concepts, including JDBC fundamentals, CDC patterns, schema evolution, query optimization, destination typing and normalization, and the Airbyte protocol (spec, discover, check, read, write).

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success for technical conversations, onboarding, and expansion efforts, bringing the kind of product depth that helps close and retain customers.



Knowledge, Process Improvement, & AI 

 - Create and maintain internal and external knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and database connector documentation to support scalability.

 - Document research and troubleshooting processes,( including CDC debugging, destination schema reconciliation, and performance tuning runbooks), to aid faster ticket resolution and team knowledge sharing.

 - Identify AI-driven opportunities for automation and process improvements that reduce support load and improve the customer experience.

 - Embrace AI-assisted workflows and contribute to developing playbooks and skills that encode repeatable troubleshooting procedures, connector debugging patterns, and onboarding Runbooks, enabling the team to scale expertise through automation.

 - Spearhead initiatives to fill organizational or support gaps and take ownership of unique projects.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

 - 2+ years in software engineering, data engineering, technical support, DevOps, QA, or a similar role supporting developers or technical users.

 - Fluency in SQL, with hands-on experience investigating query plans, isolation levels, and performance bottlenecks.

 - Proficiency in Java or Kotlin. You must be able to read, write, and debug JVM-based connector code. You'll be contributing to database sources and destinations, the Bulk CDK, and automation tooling.

 - Hands-on experience with relational databases, data warehouses, or data lakes, including concepts like CDC (Change Data Capture), schema evolution, and query optimization.

 - Experience with JDBC and common database drivers, and comfort debugging connection, authentication, SSL, and SSH tunnel issues.

 - Understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and data integration concepts, including ELT/ETL workflows.

 - Strong troubleshooting instincts, clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and a growth mindset that keeps you improving even when things get hard.

 - High tolerance for ambiguity and a natural self-starter.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, ClickHouse, or similar relational and non-relational systems.

 - Experience with data lakes and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake), and cloud object storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob).

 - Familiarity with Airbyte's Bulk CDK or contributions to open-source database connectors.

 - Experience with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes or Docker and multi-tenant architectures.

 - Background supporting developer-facing or embedded/platform products in a B2B SaaS context.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and GitHub-based open-source workflows.

 - Experience with AI-assisted development tools and building automated playbooks or Runbooks.




LOCATION:

 - Remote in U.S.




WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT AIRBYTE:

At Airbyte, we believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Our market-leading Total Rewards package is designed to help you thrive professionally and personally. Our benefits and perks include:



• Flexible PTO with a culture that encourages at least 25 days off annually
 • 16 weeks fully paid parental leave for all parents
 • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents
 • 401(k) retirement plan
 • Professional development budget, conference sponsorship, and book reimbursement
 • Commuter benefits and monthly internet reimbursement

 •  Breakfast and lunch in our San Francisco office
 • A collaborative, in-person culture focused on learning, growth, and impact



If you find this role exciting, we encourage you to apply even if you think you don’t meet all of the requirements!



We are not accepting agency submissions or recruiting firm support for this role. Unsolicited resumes will not be considered.



Airbyte is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, familial status, domestic violence victim status, veteran or military status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.



Airbyte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. Please let us know if you need assistance or accommodations due to a disability.

title: QA Analyst
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

Midjourney is an independent research lab exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species. We are a small, self-funded team focused on design, human infrastructure, and AI.

Most of the products we build don't have obvious precedents. We need a QA practice that helps us understand how they'll behave in the real world, identify problems early, and ship with confidence.

You'll work closely with product, design, and engineering throughout development, helping teams identify problems early and ship with confidence.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your days executing checklists. We expect you to think critically about how products behave, investigate difficult issues, improve how we test software, and go deep on the projects that matter most. If your favorite part of the job is making products noticeably better—and helping everyone around you build with more confidence—you'll probably enjoy it here.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Partner closely with product, design, and engineering throughout the development process.

 - Stay close to the work by leading testing efforts on our most important product initiatives.

 - Go deep on difficult problems—whether that's investigating a difficult bug, identifying edge cases, improving test coverage, or helping a team understand how a product behaves in the real world.

 - Design thoughtful test plans and identify issues before they reach users.

 - Help improve how we test software through better tooling, automation, and testing practices.

 - Reproduce issues, identify root causes, and verify fixes before release.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You've spent the last several years testing software people actually use.

 - You enjoy understanding how products behave, not just whether they work.

 - You're as comfortable investigating a subtle bug as you are thinking through an entire user flow.

 - You work well with designers, engineers, and product managers.

 - You care about quality and believe the best testing happens throughout development, not just before a release.

 - Tools like Claude Code and Cursor are part of your workflow.

 - You're excited by products that don't have established playbooks.

 - Work > ego




LOGISTICS

 - Full-time.

 - SF or NY Hybrid.

 - Compensation: 100,000–$125,000 + benefits.




TO APPLY

A resume is required.

description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.


MEET THE TEAM!

Supply Operations is the team behind Preply's tutor ecosystem - from how tutors grow and perform, to how they engage with learners and the platform. We work across Growth, Performance, Engagement, B2B, and Expansion to deliver a great tutor experience at scale.

As we expand into new subjects, new learner segments and corporate learning through Preply Business, we’re building the Supply foundations that make growth work in practice: tutors who can be discovered, matched and succeed through a clear lifecycle and a high-quality experience.

As a Senior Supply Operations Specialist, you’ll cover main investment areas of growth: Preply Business (B2B) and Expansion into non-language subjects (NLS). You’ll work closely with B2B, Expansion, RevOps, Product, Data, Growth and the other Supply and Preply teams. This is a hands-on role: you’ll run day-to-day supply operations and deliver the programs and improvements that make both areas scalable. The split between the two areas will evolve as priorities shift.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Drive Supply workstreams for priority growth areas, with a focus on tutor coverage and liquidity, quality and lifecycle readiness (includes own our program for Preply Business Tutors, improving tutor quality for our B2B learners; supply readiness for new subjects and segments in Expansion)

 - Represent Supply in cross-functional planning, so Supply implications shape priorities, sequencing and launch requirements (e.g., B2B planning with commercial partners, the Expansion squad)

 - Be the Supply point of contact for day-to-day questions and edge cases, and escalate what needs a wider decision (e.g., tutor coverage for a specific B2B deal, a tutor no-show in a sales trial)

 - Structure ambiguous problems into clear plans, workstreams and decisions, and deliver from diagnosis to rollout with Product, Data, Growth, RevOps, Expansion and other Supply teams

 - Identify the biggest supply gaps and drive the right fixes (e.g., where NLS tutors drop off in the funnel compared with language subjects; B2B tutor satisfaction and problematic lessons)

 - Strengthen the end-to-end tutor lifecycle and its foundations, from onboarding to categorization, discoverability and matching

 - Evolve tutor quality standards and guardrails that protect quality and fairness across B2B and NLS

 - Define success metrics and build dashboards for supply health with Data (e.g., liquidity and coverage, funnel health, tutor CSAT, problematic lessons)

 - Propose new opportunities by challenging assumptions and testing practical approaches, including with AI


WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

 - 4-6+ years of experience in operations, strategy & operations, consulting, marketplaces or high-growth tech roles

 - Project leadership: has led cross-functional initiatives from problem definition to rollout, with clear examples of shipped outcomes

 - Structured problem solving: can break down ambiguous topics into clear goals, options and next steps

 - Program management: structured planning, dependency management and follow-through across more than one workstream

 - Stakeholder management: works well with commercial, product and data partners, handles competing requests and trade-offs, and says no with clear reasoning

 - Data-driven approach: sizes opportunities, defines KPIs, interprets results and turns insights into actions

 - Ownership mindset: acts autonomously, anticipates issues and drives closure

 - Operational excellence: designs processes and guardrails that protect quality and reliability, and balances day-to-day support with project work

 - AI fluency: already uses AI tools in daily work and is keen to automate and improve processes with them

 - Clear communication: communicates clearly in writing and out loud, from crisp updates to explaining trade-offs in discussions and presenting recommendations to stakeholders

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and moving fast with imperfect information while keeping quality high


NICE TO HAVE:

 - B2B commercial exposure: understands sales cycles, account management realities and deal and retention constraints

 - Non-language subjects or new-vertical marketplace experience: has built or scaled supply in a new category, subject or segment (e.g., tutoring or teaching outside languages, kids, or a marketplace launching a new vertical)

 - SQL and BI fluency (e.g., Looker)

 - Familiarity with marketplace supply dynamics: quality, liquidity, incentives, eligibility

 - Marketplace or platform experience supporting a large base of supply partners (tutors, creators, sellers, drivers, etc.)

 - Passion for education and an understanding of the challenges and opportunities in the EdTech industry


WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT AT PREPLY:

 - An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;

 - A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com http://Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;

 - A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;

 - Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

 - Access to free mental health support platforms;

 - Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;

 - The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


OUR PRINCIPLES

 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

 - Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

 - Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

 - One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Preply.com http://Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. title: Account Manager UKI
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a commercially-minded Account Manager to join our Mid-Market Account Management Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help grow and expand our existing customer base and be part of the Customer Growth & Expansion team as we scale. If you're excited about strategic account management, obsessed with customer outcomes, know how to unlock expansion across complex organisation, you love nurturing relationships, identifying growth levers, proving ROI, and are passionate about spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Senior Sales Manager, Account Management and work closely with teams in Customer Success, Deal Desk, Pricing and Enablement. Our team of 16 is highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering value and growing our existing customer base. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Sales, Support, Product and Marketing to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Manager, you will:

 - Own a dedicated book of business from a purely commercial perspective, focusing heavily on a land-and-expand revenue model through cross-selling, upselling, and driving overall account growth 

 - Identify and close expansion opportunities within your book of business, securing new entities, teams, and product capabilities aligned with evolving customer needs.

 - Work hand-in-hand with Customer Success teams, who focus on customer adoption and retention, allowing you to stay fully focused on driving revenue and commercial outcomes.

 - Build deep relationships with key decision-makers (senior finance, procurement, and operations stakeholders) to understand their strategic initiatives and uncover whitespace opportunities.

 - Use MEDDICC (or similar framework) to rigorously qualify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring forecast accuracy and high deal velocity.

 - Showcase new product features, integrations, and advanced workflows. Leverage customer success stories, usage data, and ROI metrics to proactively pitch new functionality and quantify value.

 - Create custom proposals and business cases aligned with commercial goals and customer budgeting cycles, leading commercial conversations to ensure terms reflect the value Pleo delivers.




WHAT YOU BRING 

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - A solid understanding of value-based selling and consultative approach

 - Skilled in contract negotiations and building business cases linking features to value

 - Strong understanding of qualification methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC)

 - A passion for solving problems with a solution-oriented approach

 - Data-driven, goal-oriented, and accurate forecasting ability

 - Strong commercial acumen and ability to navigate senior stakeholders

 - A background in SaaS Account Management or Customer Growth with a proven track record of expansion revenue and high net revenue retention

 - Complete fluency in English


WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You are naturally curious and driven to map out complex organisations, identifying white space where Pleo can solve a genuine business need.

 - You get a rush from closing upsells by proving ROI and prefer driving proactive growth over simply waiting for a renewal.

 - You use frameworks like MEDDICC to keep deals on track and can easily show a CFO how tech features translate into financial value.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - You view Account Management solely as responding to support tickets or handling administrative renewals rather than proactively hunting for expansion opportunities and driving revenue.

 - You require a rigid, unchanging playbook to succeed. We are scaling fast, which means processes evolve and you’ll need to be comfortable building the plane while flying it.

 - You prefer simple, single-point-of-contact relationships. This role requires multi-threading across Finance, IT, and Procurement in mid-market organizations.
   
   


HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE 

In your first 6 to 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

 - Lead targeted account whitespace analysis to drive impact in your assigned market segment.

 - Collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve feedback loops that influence our mid-market product roadmap.

 - Grow your skills in complex commercial negotiation and value engineering, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale




THE LOCATION

title: Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations to join our Revenue Operations at Pleo. In this role, you'll help build the technical and operational infrastructure that enables Pleo’s revenue organisation to scale and be part of cross-functional programs as we scale Pleo's customer and revenue lifecycle. If you're excited about solving complex architectural challenges at the intersection of business systems and data and are passionate about SaaS, fintech, and modern Revenue Operations, then this is the opportunity for you!




WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO 

You’ll report to our Director of Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Sales, Customer Success, Customer Experience, Marketing, and Customer Onboarding. Our team of Revenue Operations professionals is highly collaborative and dedicated to building a scalable, reliable, and connected revenue operating system. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Data and Analytics, Business Systems, and Finance to ensure success.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Technical Program Manager, Revenue Operations, you will:

 - Lead complex technical programs across the revenue technology ecosystem – from discovery and requirements definition through architecture design, implementation, UAT, launch, and post-launch adoption.

 - Translate requirements bidirectionally – turn complex commercial challenges into precise technical specs for Engineering and Data teams, while breaking down technical trade-offs, system dependencies, and risks for business stakeholders.

 - Drive revenue systems and CRM initiatives – optimize architecture and end-to-end data flows across lead-to-opportunity, sales-to-onboarding handoffs, renewal, churn risk, and billing operations.

 - Identify and eliminate technical and operational debt – architect future-state solutions rather than quick fixes, automating manual workflows and improving data integrity across critical revenue systems.

 - Champion modern automation and AI-enabled RevOps capabilities – integrate intelligent workflows, predictive customer health signals, and agent-based workflows to accelerate commercial productivity.

 


WHAT YOU BRING 


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

 - 5+ years of Technical Program Management experience – a proven track record of managing complex technical programs involving multi-system integrations, data models, APIs, and technical dependencies.

 - A strong understanding of the SDLC and revenue mechanics – deep comfort with software development workflows (Agile/hybrid) paired with a solid grasp of the B2B revenue lifecycle (lead routing, pipeline, onboarding, retention, expansion).

 - System architecture fluency – the ability to challenge technical designs, evaluate failure scenarios, define sources of truth, and ensure long-term scalability.

 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influence – strong executive communication skills, high cross-functional influence without direct authority, and the ability to lead governance, risk tracking, and UAT.

 - Experience with HubSpot or another enterprise CRM, modern data warehouses (SQL querying), CPQ/billing tools, or integration middleware.

 - A background in SaaS, fintech, payments, spend management, or a high-growth digital environment.

This role is a good fit for you if:

 - You love being the technical bridge between revenue leaders and software/data engineers, translating strategy into scalable technical execution.

 - You think in systems, data flows, and dependencies, and prefer fixing root causes rather than patching symptoms.

 - You want true ownership of strategic programs and enjoy driving them through technical delivery to measurable business adoption.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

 - Your TPM experience is primarily administrative (focused only on timelines, meeting notes, and status reports without understanding the underlying technical architecture).

 - You are uncomfortable discussing APIs, data schemas, integrations, and failure modes directly with engineers.

 - You need fully defined requirements handed to you rather than proactively untangling ambiguity and challenging assumptions.

title: Senior Visual Designer
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Visual Designer to shape how Preply’s brand comes to life within our product.

As part of the Brand Creative team, you’ll partner with Product Designers, Product Managers across multiple squads. You’ll stay close to their roadmaps and planning, helping frame creative opportunities from the inception of a project and leading visual solutions through to delivery.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of ownership. You’ll bring independent judgment, strong visual craft and the ability to turn ambiguous challenges into clear creative direction. As a key connection between Brand and Product, you’ll also help evolve our visual language based on the needs of both teams.

What you’ll do

 - Shape projects from the start. Participate in squad planning, discovery and design sessions, identifying where brand and visual storytelling can improve the experience and influencing briefs before solutions are defined.

 - Lead creative explorations and executions. Independently lead the visual work on complex product initiatives, exploring concepts, recommending a direction and delivering polished outcomes.

 - Choose the right visual approach. Develop solutions across photography, illustration, 3D imagery, iconography, typography and motion, drawing on creative specialists where needed.

 - Represent Brand in product decisions. Build trusted relationships across squads, explain your recommendations and resolve competing needs through thoughtful design judgment.

 - Strengthen the shared visual system. Turn recurring challenges into reusable assets, principles and practical examples. Bring product learnings back into Brand to help refine our guidelines.

 - Anticipate and prioritise work. Maintain visibility across squad roadmaps, surface dependencies and align priorities with Brand and Product leads to focus effort where it matters most.

 - Raise the quality of the work. Give constructive feedback, support other designers and collaborate with Engineers through implementation to ensure the final experience meets the intended standard.

 - Scale creative solutions through AI. Develop reusable prompts, workflows and examples that enable Product Designers to generate and adapt imagery within our visual guidelines. Establish clear quality standards and help teams apply these approaches confidently in their day-to-day work.

What you’ll bring

 - A strong portfolio demonstrating senior-level visual craft, conceptual thinking and brand design applied to digital products.

 - Experience independently leading projects from an ambiguous brief through to implementation, with clear reasoning behind your decisions.

 - Excellent foundations in typography, composition, colour and visual storytelling, supported by an understanding of usability and accessibility.

 - The ability to influence cross-functional partners, navigate feedback and build alignment around a creative direction.

 - Strong Figma skills and experience creating reusable design assets and guidance.

 - Sound judgment in balancing quality, scope and timelines across multiple initiatives.

Experience with illustration, motion or generating imagery is a plus.

What success looks like

 - 8+ years of experience in visual, brand or digital design, with a portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking and visual craft.

 - At least 2 years working directly with digital product teams, collaborating with Product Designers, PMs and Engineers from discovery through implementation.

 - Experience in a consumer-facing technology company, digital platform or subscription business, ideally supporting multiple squads. Agency experience is equally relevant when it includes sustained collaboration with product teams and shipped digital experiences.

 - Examples of brand design applied within live products, such as onboarding, feature introductions, subscription journeys or progress and achievement experiences, with clear ownership of the visual direction.

 - Experience building reusable visual systems and AI workflows, including confident image generation, refinement of outputs, and prompts or guidance that enable other designers to produce consistent work.




OUR PRINCIPLES

 - Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

 - We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience.

 - Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters.

 - Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen.

 - Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently.

 - Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions.

 - Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks.

 - Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference.

 - Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made.

 - One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress.


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

Preply.com http://Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

title: Director of Public Policy, UAE/Middle East
Account Manager - Enterprise
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

You will own the full commercial relationship and customer success across a book of 25 to 50 enterprise accounts - the builders, innovators, and product teams at companies between 2,000 and 10,000 employees who are defining what AI-native experiences look, feel, and sound like. Your job is to make sure every one of them is getting real value, expanding into new products, and renewing with conviction.

This is a high-impact, high-depth role. You'll manage a focused book while building the executive relationships, success plans, and expansion motions that drive meaningful outcomes at scale. If you love the challenge of going deep with complex organizations while keeping commercial momentum, this role was built for you.

On the ground, you'll be in the product with customers - advising on agent design, voice customization, conversation flows, integrations, and using data and logs to spot friction before customers do. You're the person who connects what's working technically to what's growing commercially and partnering closely with high growth accounts to help them achieve value.

Success of the customer and commercial ownership go hand in hand and are at the core of this role. You own NRR across your managed book of business, you drive cross-sell into ElevenLabs' expanding product suite, and you lead renewals end to end. The best AMs at ElevenLabs don't just retain customers, they grow with them.




COMPENSATION

This role offers a competitive on target earnings (OTE) structure with a split of 70% base and 30% variable. Variable compensation is weighted 70% net revenue retention (NRR) and 30% product cross sell. Cross-sell performance counts toward NRR, so strong expansion compounds across both components. Quota is set on managed ARR, giving you clear ownership over a defined book of business. The plan includes accelerators for above target NRR performance and is designed to reward account managers who grow with their customers, not just retain them. Variable compensation is paid on a quarterly basis.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5 to 7 years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products - you have specific, quantified wins at the enterprise level and you can speak to them clearly

 - You own revenue outcomes end to end at the enterprise level - quota, retention, and expansion - and you run the full expansion motion yourself without a sales handoff

 - You've been in deals where the champion and the economic buyer aren't on the same page, and you know how to navigate that without losing the relationship or the deal

 - You can hold a technical conversation with a developer or engineering team and earn their trust - familiarity with AI concepts, API integrations, and SDKs is a must

 - You use product data to stay ahead of your accounts - spotting health signals, identifying expansion opportunities, and getting in front of risk before it becomes churn

 - You can present to a C-suite, troubleshoot with an engineering team, and close with a procurement lead - sometimes in the same week - and you make each conversation count

Preferred

 - Experience in the voice AI, audio AI, or conversational AI space

 - Experience selling or expanding into multiple products within a platform




LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in ET, CT, MT, or PT timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York City or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our offices in these cities. 

#LI-remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Senior Partner Marketing Manager
description:
TL;DR

The Partner Marketing team extends Lovable’s reach by educating, engaging, and enabling partners globally to build market awareness and generate demand for their Lovable-powered solutions and services. We recruit prospective partners and support the onboarding and growth of existing ones as they build, launch, market, and scale their businesses through the Lovable Partner Ecosystem. We work closely with GTM partnerships, product partnerships, sales, and product marketing, and serve partner types from major technology and platform partners to the connectors, agencies, and independent experts who build with Lovable every day.



Why Lovable?

For decades, the ability to build software belonged to a tiny fraction of the population: the people with the credentials, the technical training, the access. Everyone else had to wait, or pay, or give up. Lovable is the counterargument: We exist for the people with ideas who were locked out of software creation until now.

Over 70 million projects have been built on the platform. Hundreds of thousands of people pay for it. The product handles real infrastructure, not only prototypes: authentication, databases, payments, and deployment. People run real businesses on Lovable, which means the stakes are real too.

The comms challenge: when anyone can build, the platform has to be safe for everyone who does, and they need to know it. That takes someone who can tell the story of how we think about topics like safety, security, and reliability before anyone asks, and who can be honest, precise, and fast when the questions come up anyway.



What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced, creative, results-oriented marketer to develop and execute partner marketing initiatives across our full partner ecosystem. Connectors and integration partners are the immediate priority: Lovable’s rapidly growing connector roster (spanning search, communications, CRM, and data) needs launches, positioning, and demand generation. You’ll also work with the Lovable Partner Program team to run co-marketing campaigns and programs at scale that drive customer acquisition and activation, helping partners grow their business with and through Lovable.

You’ll set and own Lovable’s marketing with, to, and through partners, and roll up your sleeves to execute across a high-volume, fast-moving roster.

 - Work with GTM Partnerships, Product Partnerships, Sales, and (Product) Marketing to build go-to-market initiatives across connector and integration partners, hyperscalers, and services partners.

 - Define priorities, investment model, scaling mechanisms, and success metrics across partner types, with connectors as the top priority given the roster’s size and growth rate.

 - Own and evolve the tiering framework that governs marketing investment per partner, and keep it workable as the partner count grows.

 - Administer and optimize market development funds (MDF), and build the joint GTM plans needed to fully activate committed co-marketing budgets.

 - Build and run an intake and prioritization system for inbound co-marketing requests from partners.

 - Drive adoption of scalable marketing and enablement programs across the partner base, and represent partner marketing’s needs in the broader GTM and marketing roadmap.

 - Collaborate with GTM teams (including marketing) to ensure partners are represented in initiatives across all regions.

Who you are

Meet the minimum requirements below to be considered. The preferred qualifications are a bonus.

 - 8-10+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience.

 - 3+ years managing partner marketing programs or teams.

 - Experience working with technology, platform, or services partners to build joint marketing plans and run programs that drive new customer acquisition and pipeline.

 - Experience running partner marketing across a large, growing roster (an ISV-style ecosystem with dozens to hundreds of partners).

 - Proven ability to influence partner marketing leadership and align on joint objectives and plans.

 - Experience shaping joint messaging and positioning with partners.

 - Demonstrated experience measuring and improving the ROI of marketing investment in an indirect, partner-led model, including administering MDF.

 - Deep understanding of the partner channel and funnel, sales cycle, and product lifecycle, and what each requires from partner marketing to drive revenue.

Preferred qualifications

 - Experience at a dynamic, high-growth tech company.

 - Experience marketing developer tools, APIs, or platform and connector ecosystems.

 - Experience running co-marketing and MDF programs with hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure) or larger tech partners.

 - Create repeatable sales processes, performance metrics, and operating rhythms so revenue becomes more predictable as the team grows.

 - Partner with the Forward Deployed Engineer and Account Manager orgs so early deployments become references and expand across agencies.

 - Work with Marketing on public sector messaging and content, and with government affairs and policy contacts to track regulation, funding, and procurement changes.

 - Serve as the public face of ElevenLabs in the government market, at agency briefings, and industry events.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 15+ years of progressive experience in technology sales or business leadership, with at least 10 years in public sector markets.

 - Experience leading government sales teams, with a record of hiring and developing both individual contributors and managers.

 - Proven track record of securing, large ARR strategic contracts with government agencies.

 - Prior experience building a public sector business unit or equivalent leadership role at a technology company, ideally at an early or growth stage.

 - Deep knowledge of federal, state, and education procurement, including funding mechanisms, acquisition vehicles such as GSA Schedule, GWACs, and IDIQs, and how buying decisions are made.

 - Executive credibility with senior government officials, program leaders, and technical and security reviewers.

 - An established network across agencies, systems integrators, and public sector partners.

 - Comfort staying hands-on in deals while building the team and the playbook.




WHY THIS ROLE

The opportunity is to define the strategy, hire the team, and shape what we build for government, with direct support from leadership and a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs.




LOCATION

While we operate as a remote-first company, there is a strong preference for this role to be based in Washington DC.

title: Senior UX Designer
IT Manager
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payments infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payments fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.




THE ROLE

Paddle's IT team is looking for an IT Manager to lead and develop the team that keeps every Paddler equipped, connected, and secure. This is a role for someone who can operate at two altitudes at once: setting IT strategy, managing budget and vendor relationships, and leading people, while also being willing to get hands-on. You'll lead a lean team of IT engineers, own the systems that underpin how the business works day to day (identity, devices, service delivery), and be the person who pushes the function forward - using data and automation, including AI, to change how IT operates rather than just keeping the lights on.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead, coach, and develop a lean team of IT engineers - setting priorities, unblocking their hardest problems, and stepping in hands-on for complex or escalated issues.

 - Own Okta identity and access management for the business: the lifecycle, integrations, and day-to-day administration that keep joiners, movers, and leavers secure and frictionless.

 - Own macOS and Apple device management and endpoint tooling across the business, in a way that's secure by default and low-friction for Paddlers.

 - Drive the adoption of data, automation, and AI across IT operations - identifying where tooling and agents can remove manual toil, speed up support, and evolve how the team operates.

 - Set and own IT's operating rhythm: support tooling, SLAs, and the metrics that show whether the function is improving.

 - Manage the IT budget and vendor portfolio - evaluating spend, negotiating commercial terms, ensuring that we’re operating efficiently and running a SaaS estate that spans across multiple departments.

 - Implement and maintain baseline security and resilience practices for IT-owned systems (CIS Benchmarks, patching, disaster recovery), partnering closely with the wider Security team on anything that crosses into security engineering.

 - Act as the conduit between IT and the rest of the business - translating department needs into IT capabilities.
   
   


SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

At Paddle we value a growth mindset and a willingness to learn, so if you're confident in most of these skills (not necessarily all) and you're excited to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We'd love to hear from you if you:

 - Have led or managed a technical IT team before, with a track record of developing people as well as delivering outcomes.

 - Are technically credible: strong systems administration and infrastructure fundamentals, and comfortable being the escalation point when something's genuinely hard.

 - Have hands-on experience running an IAM platform in production, ideally Okta, including lifecycle automation and integrations.

 - Have in-depth knowledge of macOS and Apple hardware, ideally managing it in a corporate/enterprise environment (Iru or equivalent).

 - Are excited about AI and automation as tools for operational leverage, with examples of using them - or data and workflows more broadly - to change how a team works.

 - Can manage a budget and vendor relationships commercially: evaluating cost, negotiating terms, and knowing how to get the most out of a tool or platform.

 - Have experience running IT projects end-to-end, from scoping through delivery and stakeholder reporting.

 - Understand core security and compliance fundamentals well enough to implement and maintain them.

 - Communicate clearly and adapt your message for technical peers and non-technical senior stakeholders alike.

 - Are a strong leader who can hold a calm, clear line under pressure (incidents, competing priorities, escalations).



Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

 Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

Paddle for others

Paddle together

Paddle simply

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, retirement plans, private healthcare and wellbeing initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.



Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.



Our Paddle hubs:

 - In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

 - In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.



To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - Italian Speaking
description:

Engaging stakeholders from day-to-day users through to the C-suite, you’ll make sure customers see clear ROI and become true champions of Synthesia.




WHAT YOU'LL DO
