 - You will be helping educate clients on a totally new way to create video content, and work very closely with sales to create a cohesive onboarding experience for new users

 - You are capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organisation, including the C-suite

 - Ideal for an individual who wants to expand their career with a fast-growing software company 


 


WE’D LOVE TO HEAR FROM YOU IF YOU HAVE

 -  Customer-facing experience in Customer Success Management / Client Service / Account Management / Technical Account Management / Implementation or similar ideally in B2B SaaS

 - Experience in managing a Book of Business along with KPIs

 - A track record in managing risk, forecasting, and identifying growth opportunities

 - Establishing a trusted advisor relationship with our clients, driving value from Synthesia products and services

 - Successfully onboarding new clients and building key relationships in the first critical months and beyond

 - Coordinating and leading regular client check-ins with clear outcomes on client health and opportunities with senior stakeholder attendance

 - Light video editing using the Synthesia platform

 - Retention and growth of our enterprise clients

 - Ensuring ROI and value is understood by clients, proactively looking for risks and opportunities

 - You need to be fluent in Italian and English 

 - You are based in Europe and can sit remote. 




WE’D BE PARTICULARLY EXCITED IF

 - Experience at a fast-growing technology company

 - Familiarity with AI or video tools
   
   


COMPENSATION

We offer a competitive salary, equity and benefits. Your offer will reflect your experience, skills and the scope of the role.

title: Senior Accountant
description:

 - Maintaining accounting records in accordance with the Polish Accounting Act and the company’s accounting policies (local statutory accounting alongside primary reporting under US GAAP).

 - Working with an external partner to implement and launch a new NetSuite module tailored to Polish regulatory requirements.

 - Reporting issues and errors during and after implementation.

 - Participating in monthly and annual closes and preparing the company’s financial statements.

 - Liaising with external authorities and preparing documentation, including contact with tax offices, the Social Insurance Institution (ZUS) and Statistics Poland (GUS), as well as supporting audits.

 - Monitoring changes in tax and accounting regulations and implementing the necessary updates to processes and the system.

 - Contributing to improvements in accounting processes.

 - Hands-on with a planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive or similar), comfortable with SQL and working off a data warehouse, and you use AI tools every day.

About Exeon

Exeon is a Swiss cyber security company based in Zurich. Since 2016, we have been protecting critical infrastructures, financial institutions and enterprises whose operations fully rely on IT through AI-powered analysis of network communication. This makes the most sophisticated cyberattacks visible – attacks conventional tools fail to detect. We combine Swiss excellence with a flexible, remote-first, and collaborative culture, supporting passionate, ambitious professionals devoted to solving cybersecurity challenges and driving continuous innovation.

What your impact will be like:

As a Senior Frontend Developer at Exeon, you will be responsible for our UEBA (User and Entity Behaviour Analytics) product. You will work in a small cross-functional team of backend engineers, frontend engineers and quality assurance engineers on a data-heavy single-page application that enterprise customers use to analyze network traffic and identify potential security risks. This data is rendered as tables, graphs and dashboards. You will build out the frontend alongside our frontend engineers, while also helping to shape the overall UI and UX of the product and take its appearance and functionality to the next level.

In particular, you will:

  • Develop and maintain front-end components for Exeon's UEBA product, an enterprise data analysis SPA built with React with emphasis on responsive design, performance optimization and code quality (unit and integration tests).

  • Translate complex user and entity behavior data and network security insights into intuitive visual representations (tables, graphs, dashboards), applying strong information architecture and UX principles.

  • Handle large datasets and optimize frontend rendering to ensure responsive, performant user interfaces, even when working with complex data visualizations.

title: Head of Strategy & Operations
description:
About remove

remove is a non-profit organisation with a mission to enable innovators globally to realize the "net" in net zero. remove has established premier global startup accelerator programs focused solely on Carbon Dioxide Removal (CDR) across Europe, India, Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. To date, we have supported over 200 startups and cultivated a global CDR community. We also develop CDR ecosystems and engage in strategic projects to close systemic gaps in carbon removal globally. We are a small, remote team that works like a startup: high standards, an agile approach and a lot of ownership per person. Our work is funded by leading climate foundations and philanthropic partners such as The Grantham Foundation for the Protection of the Environment and Postcode Loterij Fonds.

About the role

We are looking for a senior professional to lead strategy and operations at remove, managing our talent and running the engine that keeps us moving. You will work very closely with our two co-founders, manage our program managers, and be the person who makes sure the right things get done, well and on time, as we grow our impact in new ways and into new regions at a pivotal stage of our organization.

What you will own

Strategy

  • Lead strategic thinking, be a sounding board to the co-founders, and the person who "writes the strategy down" and plans for its execution.

  • Prepare and run strategy days, offsites and team meetups.

  • Own key strategic documents and shape important external documents.

Planning and Operations

  • Develop and own our roadmap and workplans. Keep everyone accountable to shared goals and spot early and proactively when plans need to change.

  • Own our operating rhythm: recurring meetings, brainstorms, 1:1s, team updates, retros and milestone planning.

  • Develop and improve the processes and documentation the team relies on, including program SOPs and team policies.

  • Lead hiring and onboarding for new team members and external support, and plan team capacity as we grow. We are not expecting to grow team members in large numbers; we intend to remain a lean and mighty team.

  • Look after team health and ways of working in a fully remote, multicultural team.

Fundraising operations

  • Run the process behind the co-founders’ fundraising efforts.

  • Maintain and develop core materials such as our decks, concept notes and one-pagers, and draft or coordinate grant applications.

  • Own impact reporting content and contribute to funder reports.

Strategic projects & programs

  • Scope & lead strategic initiatives from idea to delivery, alongside recurring work.

  • Oversee our programs and systems as we expand.

  • Oversee our entity’s brand and communications.

Who you are

You must have

  • 12+ years of experience, including roles where you ran strategy, operations and/or a PMO for a leadership team. You have done this job before with a laser focus on high standards and timely execution. You don’t let things fall through the cracks.

  • Experience supporting fundraising or business development, e.g. pipelines, proposals and reporting.

  • A track record of managing people well, ideally in small remote teams.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can build structure where there is none and adjust it as things change.

  • Resourcefulness and agency. You see what needs doing and do it without waiting to be asked, including the unglamorous parts. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and drive in conceptualising and executing initiatives, with strong organisational and documentation skills.

  • Excellent communication, writing and synthesis. You can turn a messy conversation into a clear plan, deck or proposal.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire and persuade diverse groups, in a cross-cultural remote setting.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote workspace, meeting deadlines and managing several work streams simultaneously.

  • Adaptability, curiosity and eagerness to keep learning in a dynamic environment.

  • Ability to speak and write in English fluently.

  • Willingness to travel locally or occasionally regionally/globally, if necessary.

It is a plus if you have

  • A university degree (MSc. preferred) in a relevant field (e.g. environmental science, engineering, sustainability, business administration)

  • Experience in and a strong passion for climate action, carbon removal or the wider sustainability field.

  • Experience with accelerators, startups or entrepreneurship programs.

  • Experience with foundations or philanthropic funding.

  • Experience working in or with partners in the Global South.

  • A coaching or facilitation background.

Practicalities

  • This role reports to the two co-founders.

  • Location: remote, in Europe. Preference will be given to those based in Northwestern Europe due to proximity to the co-founders. Occasional travel for team meetups and selected events.

  • Contract: full time, with start date April 1, 2027. Depending on your location, you may be employed through an employer-of-record provider. You must be able to work in your country of residence. We will not sponsor visas or work permits.

  • Salary: competitive for non-profit salary bands for small teams in your location.

What we offer

  • A flexible and remote-first workplace.

  • An impact-driven role as part of a mission-driven team and organisation working with entrepreneurs globally.

  • A unique opportunity to experience and shape strategy for a future billion-dollar industry in its early days.

Submit your CV and a short cover letter (no more than one page) detailing your relevant experience and why you believe you would be the ideal candidate for the role. We will review applications on a rolling basis and aim to start interviews as soon as possible, latest by mid November 2026.

Our process: a 30-minute introductory call with Rawan Gebran (Senior Director @ remove) followed by a take home task that you will present, then an interview with both co-founders, Hans Westerhof & Marian Krueger and a conversation with the team. We aim to make a decision by January 2027 for a start in April 2027. In the final round, we will ask for the contact details of 3 references willing to speak about their experience with you, professionally.

If you’ve built and run the strategic and operating backbone for a small and agile team before and want to do it for the organization helping CDR startups globally get off the ground, we want to hear from you! We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Principal of backend
description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We're fully remote (we were doing it before it was fashionable!), although we get together twice a year for Team Retreats.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal



This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

How You'll Lead



Success in this role comes through influence rather than authority.

We don't want every difficult technical decision to end with:

"We'd better ask the Principal Engineer."

If an engineer proposes an approach you disagree with, we don't just want you to replace it with your own.

Understand their thinking. Ask questions. Challenge assumptions. Explore the trade-offs. Share your experience.

And be prepared to change your own mind too.

The goal is to leave that engineer better equipped to solve the next problem, not just holding the answer to this one.

Your technical impact should multiply through the people around you.

You'll remain close enough to the code to understand what's actually happening and occasionally roll up your sleeves to prototype, investigate a difficult problem or unblock a team.

But if after a year you've personally written loads of brilliant software while everyone around you is working exactly as they were before, we haven't succeeded.

The Technical Challenge



Our platform has been evolving for more than 25 years.

At its heart is a mature C# .NET Framework 4.7 monolith, alongside an expanding ecosystem of modern C# .NET 10 and TypeScript services.

Our backend estate includes:


  • .NET Framework and modern C#/.NET.
  • TypeScript services.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Redis.
  • Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Cloudflare platform services.
  • API-first architecture.
  • Git-based development workflows.


We're continuing to modernise, but we're not interested in modernisation for modernisation's sake.

We aren't trying to win an award for having the most fashionable architecture diagram.

We want a secure, reliable and maintainable platform that can support SchemeServe for many years to come – and we want you to help us decide what should evolve and, just as importantly, what doesn't need changing.

What You'll Do



You'll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to:


  • Shape our backend engineering strategy, architecture and technical direction.
  • Help engineers make better technical and architectural decisions.
  • Develop sensible engineering principles and guardrails without replacing good judgement with rules.
  • Guide the continued evolution of our monolith and modern service-based platform.
  • Coach and mentor engineers, developing their technical skills and judgement.
  • Review significant designs and architectural decisions and challenge unnecessary complexity.
  • Champion security, quality, testing, observability, resilience and performance.
  • Identify technical risks and help teams navigate them.
  • Evaluate technologies and patterns based on their value to SchemeServe rather than their popularity elsewhere.
  • Balance long-term engineering quality with short-term business needs.
  • Occasionally contribute directly to implementation when that's genuinely the best way to help.
  • Be a generally awesome person.


What We're Looking For



You'll need:


  • Deep expertise in modern backend engineering and strong commercial C#/.NET experience.
  • Strong knowledge of software architecture, distributed systems and API design.
  • Experience with mature legacy applications and modern service-oriented architectures.
  • Strong cloud architecture experience, ideally Azure.
  • Excellent understanding of databases, security, testing, maintainability and modern software delivery.
  • Experience shaping engineering principles and practices across teams.
  • A track record of making engineers around you better through mentoring, coaching and technical leadership.
  • The ability to challenge experienced engineers constructively without becoming a gatekeeper.
  • Strong opinions, loosely held – the confidence to challenge and the humility to change your mind.
  • Excellent communication and the ability to influence without relying on authority.
  • Excellent technical judgement, balancing quality, complexity, risk, cost and business value.


Most importantly, we're looking for someone who asks:

"What's the right solution for us?"

rather than:

"What's the way everyone else is doing it?"

Nice To Have


  • Experience modernising large monolithic applications.
  • Commercial TypeScript backend experience.
  • Cloudflare or edge technology experience.
  • SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Financial services, insurance or another regulated industry.
  • Observability, platform engineering or SRE experience.
  • AI-assisted development and engineering productivity tooling.


You don't need to tick every box.

If you've got the technical depth, judgement and ability to make engineers around you better, we'd rather have a conversation than lose a great candidate because you haven't used one particular technology.

What Success Looks Like



Within your first year:


  • Engineers are making stronger technical and architectural decisions with greater confidence.
  • Our engineering principles are understood rather than blindly followed.
  • Technical discussions are constructive, pragmatic and result in clear decisions.
  • Security, reliability, maintainability and performance concerns are identified earlier.
  • We've made sensible progress modernising our platform without adding complexity for complexity's sake.
  • You've made a lasting positive impact on both our software and the people who build it.


Ultimately, we don't want SchemeServe to become dependent on you for every difficult technical decision.

We want SchemeServe to become better at making those decisions because you're here.

Why Join SchemeServe?


  • Fully remote UK-based role.
  • Twice-yearly company retreats.
  • Flexible working.
  • Dedicated professional development support.
  • Paid charity days.


  • Friendly, supportiv...

description:
Du kennst dich mit Klaviyo aus, hast bereits E-Commerce-Marken betreut und möchtest weitere eigene Kunden und ein Team verantworten? Dann könnte das hier gut passen.

Wir sind eine Agentur für E-Mail- und SMS-Marketing. Wir unterstützen DTC-Marken mit sieben- und achtstelligen Umsätzen dabei, mehr aus ihrem E-Mail-Marketing herauszuholen und langfristig zu wachsen.

Bei uns übernimmst du die Betreuung mehrerer Kunden. Du entwickelst die Strategie, planst Kampagnen und koordinierst die Umsetzung mit deinem Team aus Copywriter, Designer und Klaviyo-Technician. Dabei behältst du die Ergebnisse im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden jederzeit wissen, woran wir arbeiten.

Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt, klar kommuniziert und seine Aufgaben selbstständig voranbringt.

WICHTIG: Erfahrung bei einer Agentur oder Brand ist Pflicht. Bitte bewerbe dich ansonsten nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kunden betreuen: Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, hältst sie auf dem Laufenden und kümmerst dich um Feedback und Freigaben.

  • Strategien entwickeln: Du planst Kampagnen, Flows und Pop-ups, die zur jeweiligen Marke und ihren Zielen passen.

  • Kampagnen planen: Du erstellst die monatlichen Kampagnenkalender und bringst eigene Ideen für Themen, Angebote und Tests ein.

  • Qualität prüfen: Du kontrollierst Texte, Designs und die technische Umsetzung. Du achtest darauf, dass jede E-Mail zur Marke passt und vor dem Versand sorgfältig geprüft wird.

  • Ordnung halten: Du sorgst für eine übersichtliche Struktur in Figma und Klaviyo, damit dein Team gut zusammenarbeiten kann.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre im E-Mail-Marketing für E-Commerce- oder DTC-Marken gearbeitet, entweder direkt bei einer Marke oder in einer Agentur.

  • Klaviyo-Kenntnisse: Du arbeitest sicher mit Klaviyo und kennst dich mit Flows, Kampagnen und Segmentierung aus. Auch im SMS-Marketing bringst du fundierte Kenntnisse mit.

  • Organisation: Du kannst mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig betreuen und behältst Aufgaben, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Blick.

  • Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zügig, ohne wichtige Details zu übersehen.

  • Erreichbarkeit: Du kannst von 9:00 bis 17:00 Uhr MEZ weitgehend ungestört arbeiten und antwortest während dieser Zeit in der Regel innerhalb von 60 Minuten auf Slack.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Freelance: Du kannst von dort arbeiten, wo du dich wohlfühlst und gut konzentrieren kannst. Außerdem kannst du nebenbei noch andere Kunden betreuen.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle

Du bist auf Instagram oder TikTok unterwegs und denkst dir regelmäßig: Der Creator würde perfekt zu Funzy passen? Du gehst gerne auf Menschen zu, hast Spaß daran, neue Kontakte zu knüpfen und aus einer ersten Nachricht eine richtig gute Zusammenarbeit entstehen zu lassen?

Dann könnte diese Rolle gut zu dir passen.

Als Influencer Marketing Manager bringst du Funzy mit den richtigen Influencern und Creatorn zusammen. Du findest spannende neue Kontakte, begleitest Kooperationen von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Content und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Ansätze für unser Influencer Marketing.

Dabei bist du nah at Social Media, Creatorn und Content – und kannst deine eigenen Ideen direkt einbringen und ausprobieren.

Aufgaben:

  • Du identifizierst passende Influencer und Creator für Funzy, sprichst sie proaktiv an und gewinnst sie für eine Zusammenarbeit.
  • Du betreust bestehende Influencer- und Creator-Kooperationen und entwickelst langfristige Beziehungen.
  • Du koordinierst Kooperationen von der ersten Abstimmung über Briefings und Content-Produktion bis zur finalen Umsetzung.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Ideen und Formate für unser Influencer Marketing und setzt diese operativ um.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Umsetzung von UGC Content und Ads und koordinierst dafür Creator, Briefings und Content-Produktionen.
  • Du behältst laufende Kooperationen und deren Ergebnisse im Blick und nutzt deine Learnings, um unsere Aktivitäten kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation

Must-have:

  • Erste praktische Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.
  • Du bist kommunikativ und hast Spaß daran, Creator proaktiv anzusprechen und Beziehungen aufzubauen.
  • Du bist gut organisiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kooperationen den Überblick.
  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Social Media, Creator und Content und bewegst dich sicher auf Instagram und TikTok.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und bringst gerne eigene Ideen ein.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Nice to have

  • Erste Erfahrung mit UGC Content oder UGC Ads.
  • Erfahrung in einer DTC-Brand, einem E-Commerce-Unternehmen, Start-up oder einer Agentur.
  • Interesse an der Familien-, Lifestyle- oder Interior-Welt.

Benefits

  • Einblicke in die spannende Welt eines dynamisch wachsenden E-Commerce-Start-ups mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, unsere Marke aktiv mitzuprägen.

title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d) – Remote
description:
Worum es geht

MAIA ist eine KI-Plattform für Unternehmen. Mit MAIA durchsuchen Teams ihre internen Daten und verankern Agenten tief in ihren Prozessen. Wir begleiten Unternehmen dabei, KI nicht nur in einzelnen Abteilungen, sondern im ganzen Unternehmen einzusetzen.

Technisch heißt das: Wir bauen eine GenAI-Anwendung mit eigenen Agentensystemen, RAG-Pipelines und agentenbasierten Workflows, binden externe Systeme unserer Kunden an und analysieren ihre Daten. Wir nutzen die besten verfügbaren Modelle, betrieben in der EU, und machen sie verlässlich für anspruchsvolle Arbeit mit großen, komplexen Datenmengen.

Zahlreiche Industrieunternehmen arbeiten seit Jahren intensiv mit MAIA. Nach unserer erfolgreichen Finanzierungsrunde 2026 bringen wir MAIA jetzt in die Breite. Entwickelt wird MAIA seit 2021 in Leipzig.

Was du bei uns machst

Als Lead AI Engineer führst du unser Engineering-Team, entwickelst rund drei Viertel deiner Zeit selbst mit und arbeitest eng mit unserem CTO zusammen.

Deine Schwerpunkte:

  • Selbst entwickeln. Du übernimmst anspruchsvolle Features und Architekturthemen in unseren Agenten-, RAG- und Workflow-Systemen und schreibst Pläne, an denen sich andere orientieren.

  • Technische Richtung. Du triffst wichtige Designentscheidungen mit, priorisierst gemeinsam mit dem CTO die technische Roadmap und treibst die technische Vision von MAIA voran.

  • Das Team anführen. Du koordinierst die Arbeit im Team und bist Sparringspartner für alle Engineers, in Designdiskussionen, Reviews und Feedback. Du führst technische Interviews und entscheidest mit, wen wir einstellen.

  • Besser werden, gemeinsam. Mit dem Team verbesserst du laufend, wie wir entwickeln, gerade im agentischen Arbeiten: von Plänen und Reviews über Evals bis zu Releases.

  • Am Puls der Technik. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen bei LLMs, Retrieval, Agenten und darüber hinaus, bewertest sie nüchtern und bringst ins Produkt, was trägt.

Was wir suchen

  • Ein herausragender AI Engineer. Du hast LLM-Systeme gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. RAG, Embeddings, Vektorsuche, Tool Calling und Agenten kennst du aus der Praxis, auch die Stellen, an denen sie scheitern. Neue Modelle und Techniken probierst du aus eigenem Antrieb aus und trennst dabei Substanz von Hype.

  • Starke Architektur. Du hast Backend-Systeme gebaut, ausgeliefert und über längere Zeit in Produktion betrieben. Du triffst Designentscheidungen, die auch in einem Jahr noch tragen, und erkennst schwache Architektur auch dann, wenn ein Coding Agent sie geschrieben hat.

  • Sehr gut in mindestens einer unserer Sprachen. TypeScript, Python oder Go, am besten eine der statisch typisierten. Alle drei musst du nicht mitbringen. In die anderen arbeitest du dich ein.

  • Technische Führung. Du hast ein Team als Tech Lead, Lead Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle fachlich geführt. Wie die Rolle hieß, ist zweitrangig. Du gibst Verantwortung ab und freust dich, wenn das Team ohne dich gute Entscheidungen trifft. Gleichzeitig entwickelst du gern selbst weiter, denn diese Rolle ist keine reine Managementrolle.

  • Messen statt vermuten. Du weißt, wie man Systeme testet und evaluiert, die auf dieselbe Frage nicht immer gleich antworten. Du baust die einfachste Lösung, die das Problem löst. Weitere Retrieval-Stufen, Prompt-Ketten oder Abstraktionen kommen erst dazu, wenn Messungen sie rechtfertigen.

  • Agentisch arbeiten. Coding Agents gehören für dich zum Alltag. Du hast eine klare Meinung dazu, wie ein Team mit ihnen schnell bleibt, ohne an Qualität zu verlieren.

  • Remote führen. Du führst auch aus der Ferne wirksam. Du kommunizierst proaktiv, machst Entscheidungen schriftlich nachvollziehbar und bist für das Team gut erreichbar.

  • Sicherheit mitdenken. Unsere Kunden vertrauen uns ihr internes Wissen an. Mandantentrennung, Zugriffsrechte und sichere Entwicklung sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Klar kommunizieren. Du sprichst Probleme früh an, argumentierst mit Belegen und erklärst technische Entscheidungen verständlich, im Team ebenso wie gegenüber Produktmanagement, Customer Success und Vertrieb. Du sprichst sehr sicher Deutsch und ebenso Englisch.

Arbeiten bei MAIA

Uns verbindet ein gemeinsames Ziel: ein richtig gutes Produkt zu bauen. Jede und jeder übernimmt Verantwortung für das eigene Thema. Wir haben Spaß an der Arbeit und sind stolz auf das, was unsere Kunden mit MAIA erreichen. Die Wege sind kurz, und Entscheidungen fallen schnell. Im Engineering-Team hinterfragen wir kritisch, wie wir entwickeln, und verbessern unsere Prozesse laufend, gerade in der agentischen Entwicklung.

Ein großer Teil des Teams arbeitet gemeinsam in unserem Büro in Leipzig, zentral zwischen Innenstadt und Zoo, und kocht fast jeden Tag zusammen. Du arbeitest remote von überall in Deutschland, dein Wohnsitz muss in Deutschland liegen. Zweimal im Jahr treffen wir uns zu Team-Events, und ab und zu gibt es Teamtage in Leipzig. Wann dein Tag beginnt, legst du selbst fest.

  • Zugang zu aktuellen Frontier-Modellen und Coding Agents

  • Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen, auch zu Führungsthemen

  • Zugang zu einer Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

Vergütung

Das Jahresbruttogehalt liegt bei 90.000 bis 100.000 €. Wo du in dieser Spanne liegst, besprechen wir spätestens nach dem Interview zu Technik und Führung. Dazu kommt eine virtuelle Beteiligung über unser VSOP.

Bewerbung und nächste Schritte

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und beantworte uns in ein paar eigenen Sätzen eine Frage: Warum willst du MAIA mitgestalten?

Wir arbeiten jeden Tag mit KI. Für diese Antwort zählt aber deine eigene Perspektive. Schreib sie deshalb bitte selbst, gern kurz und ohne Feinschliff.

Passt es, folgen ein 30-minütiges Kennenlernen, ein 90-minütiges Interview zu Technik und Führung und ein Abschlussgespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Nach jedem Schritt hörst du in der Regel innerhalb von zwei Werktagen von uns. Unser Ziel ist eine Entscheidung in rund drei Wochen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: (Senior) Product Engineer – AI (m/f/d) – Remote
description:
What we do

MAIA is an AI platform for companies. With MAIA, teams search their internal data and embed agents deep into their processes. We help companies use AI not just in individual departments, but across the entire organisation.

On a technical level, this means: we build a GenAI application with our own agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent-based workflows, connect our customers' external systems and analyse their data. We use the best available models, operated in the EU, and make them reliable for demanding work with large, complex datasets.

Many industrial companies have been using MAIA intensively for years. Following our successful 2026 funding round, we are now taking MAIA to a broader market. MAIA has been developed in Leipzig since 2021.

What you'll do

As a Product Engineer, you own features from start to finish: from conversations with customers and concept work through to implementation and continuous improvement in production.

What you can work on:

  • Understanding customers and the market. You talk to users, join customer meetings and analyse usage data. This way, you find out where MAIA can help most in people's daily work. You work closely with product management and customer success.

  • From problem to concept. You write concepts, build prototypes to test ideas quickly, and slice features so they reach users early.

  • Building across the full stack. You write the implementation plan, let coding agents implement it, and own architecture and quality, from the data model to the user interface.

  • AI that people understand. You shape how people work with MAIA: asking questions, providing context, letting agents complete multi-step tasks and following their results.

  • Measuring and improving. After a release, you check whether a feature is used and actually helps, and you keep improving it based on feedback, usage data and evals.

What we're looking for

  • Solid software engineering. You have built products that people use every day and operated them in production, across backend and frontend. You recognise weak architecture even when a coding agent wrote it.

  • Very strong in at least one of our languages. TypeScript, Python or Go, ideally one of the statically typed ones. You don't need all three. You'll get up to speed in the others.

  • Product experience. You have talked to customers, questioned requirements and taken features from the first idea to daily use. You listen closely and recognise the problem behind a request.

  • A feel for good usability. You notice when an interface overwhelms people, and you'd rather build a simple solution that people understand than a powerful one that nobody finds.

  • At home in the LLM ecosystem. You have built applications with LLMs, professionally or in complex personal projects, and you know their quirks: answers vary, take time, and agents fail in unexpected places. You build products that deal with this honestly.

  • Measure, don't guess. You check whether a feature works using usage data, feedback and evals. You build the simplest solution that solves the problem.

  • Agentic engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily work. You write plans that others review and that coding agents can build on, you review the results critically, and you know where agents help and where they don't.

  • Remote-ready. You communicate proactively, document your work so others can follow it, and move things forward without constant coordination.

  • Clear communication. People understand your concepts on first read. You enjoy talking to customers as much as to engineers. You are fluent in English. German is a strong plus, as many of our customer conversations are in German.

This role has no people management responsibility. Whether you join at regular or senior level is something we'll discuss openly with you after the technical interview at the latest.

Working at MAIA

We share a common goal: building a really great product. Everyone takes ownership of their own area. We enjoy our work and are proud of what our customers achieve with MAIA. Paths are short and decisions are made quickly. In the engineering team, we critically question how we develop and continuously improve our processes, especially in agentic development.

Much of the team works together in our office in Leipzig, centrally located between the city centre and the zoo, where we cook together almost every day. You work remotely from anywhere in Germany. You need to live in Germany for this role. Twice a year, we meet in person for team events, and from time to time there are team days in Leipzig. When your day starts is up to you.

  • Access to the latest frontier models and coding agents

  • Support for training that fits your professional development

  • Access to a Wellpass membership

Compensation

The annual gross salary is €75,000 to €95,000. Where you fall within this range depends on your level. We'll discuss this after the technical interview at the latest. On top of that, you receive a virtual share in our VSOP.

Application and next steps

You don't need a cover letter. Send us your CV and answer one question in a few sentences of your own: Why do you want to help shape MAIA?

We work with AI every day. For this answer, though, your own perspective is what counts. So please write it yourself. Short and unpolished is fine.

If there's a fit, you'll have a 30-minute intro call, a 90-minute technical interview that also covers product decisions and a final conversation with our management. After each step, you'll usually hear from us within two business days. Our goal is a decision in about three weeks.

We look forward to your application.

Deepdesk, part of AnywhereNow, powers AI Assistants and Virtual Agents for enterprise contact centres, helping brands such as Achmea, Vodafone and DHL boost productivity today while scaling for the future of customer experience. As part of AnywhereNow, a global leader in customer experience technology with 220 colleagues worldwide, we combine the agility of a scale-up with the strength of an established enterprise provider.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced developer to join our small engineering team. The centre of the role is backend development in Python or Go and cloud infrastructure, with some front-end work alongside.

At Deepdesk, we are building “Augmented Intelligence” for the enterprise. Think Gmail Smart Compose for contact centres. Alongside recommendations, we offer fully virtual assistants that can take care of repetitive tasks.

You will work on the services behind this: the Python and Go services and APIs, the data stores and the cloud infrastructure that run our product for enterprise customers, including the services that serve our recommendation models. You will also pick up front-end work where it helps the product, for example in our admin interface and widgets.

We have a start-up culture, but your code is directly used and proven at scale. Our technology is cutting-edge and continually evolving.

description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role Overview

As Influencer Marketing Manager, you will develop and run Hilo’s influencer marketing program across our key markets. You will find creators whose voices and audiences fit our brand, negotiate effective partnerships, and shape content that makes Hilo relevant and credible. The role combines brand and performance: you will use data to estimate the potential of each partnership before we invest, measure its results, and apply what you learn to future campaigns.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Identify, assess, and recruit creators across relevant platforms and markets.
  • Develop campaign concepts that balance Hilo’s brand goals with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Forecast likely reach, engagement, traffic, and acquisition outcomes to guide creator selection and budgets.
  • Negotiate fees, deliverables, timelines, and content usage rights, including rights to use creator content in paid campaigns.
  • Manage partnerships end to end, from briefing and content review through publication and reporting.
  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with creators and brand ambassadors to drive sustained awareness, trust, and advocacy.
  • Collaborate with paid media teams to amplify high-performing creator content across paid social and other relevant channels.
  • Set clear goals, track brand and performance metrics, and compare results with initial estimates.
  • Use campaign data and audience insights to improve creator selection, content formats, and investment decisions.
  • Work across marketing and product to align campaigns with Hilo’s priorities and approved health claims.
  • Build repeatable processes that support growth across the US, UK, Germany, and other markets.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 2 years of hands-on influencer or creator marketing experience, including managing partnerships from start to finish.
  • A data-driven mindset: you can estimate campaign outcomes, assess performance, and turn findings into better decisions.
  • Strong creative judgment and an understanding of how creator content builds both brand trust and customer demand.
  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence working with creators and their representatives.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Fluency in English; German is a plus.
  • Experience in health tech, wellness, medical devices, or another category where trust and accurate claims matter is welcome.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

title: Director of Strategic Accounts

description:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. title: Talent Sourcer (gn) / Recruiter (gn) - 100% REMOTE
description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Eine Führungskraft mit zehn Jahren Bauerfahrung schreibt keine Bewerbungen. Sie steht auf der Baustelle. Die meisten schicken ihr eine Nachricht und warten. Du fasst nach, greifst zum Telefon und holst sie ins Gespräch. Wenn das nach dir klingt, lies weiter.

JIRO ist eine Personalberatung für Bau und Infrastruktur mit Kunden in ganz Europa. Wir besetzen anspruchsvolle Führungspositionen, die lange offen bleiben. Für diese Suche bauen wir ein Sourcing-Team aus Leuten auf, denen Durchschnitt nicht reicht.

Arbeite, wann du willst. Wo du willst. So viel du willst.

Dein Job in vier Schritten

  • Finden. Auf den gängigen Portalen und in Netzwerken suchst du die Profile, die zu unseren Stellen passen. Zu jeder Stelle bekommst du ein Briefing.
  • Ansprechen. Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, nicht nach Vorlage oder KI.
  • Dranbleiben. Bleibt die Antwort aus, hakst du nach. Zeigt jemand Interesse, greifst du zum Telefon. Du bleibst am Ball, bis aus einem Vielleicht ein Termin wird.
  • Termin legen. Das Erstgespräch buchst du direkt im Kalender deines Kollegen. Ab da übernimmt er.

Vertrieb, Kundentermine und CRM-Pflege gehören nicht zu deinem Job. Deine ganze Energie geht ins Sourcing.

Wann, wo und wie viel: Du entscheidest

Wann du willst. Early Bird oder Nachteule, deine Entscheidung. Uns interessiert, was du lieferst, nicht ob dein Teams-Status grün ist.

Wo du willst. Du arbeitest zu 100 % remote. Lust auf ein paar Wochen Dubai, Lissabon oder Catania? Workation ist bei uns gern gesehen. Einzige Regel: Telefoniert wird, wenn Europa wach ist.

So viel du willst. Wie viel du rausholst, entscheidest du selbst.

Dein Verdienst hat keinen Deckel

Deine Vergütung setzt sich aus vier Teilen zusammen:

  • eine feste Basis
  • eine Provision für jedes Gespräch, das du legst
  • eine Provision für jede Einstellung, die daraus entsteht
  • Extra-Boni, die wir spontan ausloben, etwa für geknackte Ziele oder brennende Stellen

Was du außerdem bekommst

  • Jeden Tag gemeinsam besser. Wir treffen uns täglich als Team. Was hat funktioniert, was nicht, was machen wir morgen anders? Wir wachsen zusammen, nicht jeder für sich.
  • Feedback, das dich weiterbringt. Wir sagen dir offen, was gut lief und wo noch Luft ist. Ehrlich, direkt, ohne Watte.
  • Stillstand gibt’s nicht. Suche, Ansprache, Nachfassen: Wir testen, messen und schärfen nach. Was besser funktioniert, wird Standard für dich und das ganze Team.
  • Aufstieg für alle, die Bock haben. Sourcing ist bei uns keine Sackgasse. Wer mehr will und das zeigt, wächst in die nächste Rolle.
  • Kleines Team, kurze Wege. Schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Corporate-Blabla, kein „Dafür bin ich nicht zuständig”.
  • Die Werkzeuge zahlen wir. Profi-Zugänge zu den gängigen Portalen gehen auf uns.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du kannst mit Menschen. Ob aus Recruiting, Vertrieb, Promotion oder Einzelhandel: Du weißt, wie man Fremde in wenigen Sätzen für sich gewinnt. Recruiting-Erfahrung hilft, ist aber keine Bedingung.
  • Du schreibst kurz und persönlich, ohne Floskeln.
  • Hängt eine Suche fest, gibst du nicht auf, sondern probierst den nächsten Weg.
  • Rankings spornen dich an, und du willst ganz oben stehen.
  • Du ziehst durch, auch wenn niemand daneben sitzt.
  • Was du zusagst, hältst du.
  • Du sprichst und schreibst sicheres Deutsch.
  • Pluspunkte: Erfahrung mit Recruiting-Portalen oder mit dem Bau.

Nichts für dich, wenn …

  • … es dir egal ist, ob du einen Termin mehr oder weniger legst.
  • … du lieber Kunden betreust und Abschlüsse machst. Dafür gibt es unsere Stelle als Recruitment Consultant (360°).
  • … du jemanden brauchst, der dir morgens die To-do-Liste schreibt.

So geht’s weiter

  • Kennenlern-Call: Wir lernen uns kennen, du stellst deine Fragen, und wir legen dir die Zahlen zu deinem Verdienst offen.
  • Short Case: Du bekommst eine echte offene Stelle, findest passende Profile und schreibst eine Ansprache. Kein halber Arbeitstag. Wer mehr liefert als verlangt, fällt uns auf.
  • Start: Zugänge, Briefing, los.

Lebenslauf oder LinkedIn-Profil reicht für den ersten Schritt.

Make your move.

As a Security Engineer in our Solutions team, you will help design the components and data flow of our core products: how data gets in, how deployments are configured and operated, and how everything scales across very different customer environments, many of them on-prem and air-gapped. 

You’ll split your time between building (ingestion pipelines, automation, tooling) and deploying and operating (working with customers to get Exeon running reliably in their environments), so your work shapes both scalability and customer success.

In particular, you will:

  • Work with customers to understand their data sources, infrastructure constraints, and security needs, and translate these into clear requirements for product and engineering teams

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
Studio is where creators build and finish video on ElevenLabs, powered by our generative graph engine, Flows. You’ll own our “produce once, distribute everywhere” workflow. It takes a finished Studio project and runs it through our dubbing pipeline to produce it in many languages and aspect ratios, with auto-translated captions. Today that means duplicating and rebuilding projects by hand.
This work is entirely greenfield: the specs aren’t written yet. You’ll shape them through written proposals (RFCs), pressure-test data structures with the team lead, and carry the project from first draft to launch.
You’re a strong backend generalist who is good with complex data structures and has the product instincts to decide what’s worth building.

Requirements

  • Strong backend generalist who has designed and shipped complex, data-heavy systems end to end.

  • Comfortable with enterprise-grade concerns such as usage reporting and accounts.

  • Evidence of product ownership: side projects, open source, or work in a product-facing context.

  • Has taken projects from inception to launch with little hand-holding.

Bonus: experience with media or video-processing pipelines (helpful, not required)

title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) - 100% Remote Worldwide
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of the AI model team, you will drive innovation in multi-modal reinforcement learning to advance next-generation intelligent systems. Your work will focus on optimizing decision-making and adaptive behavior across integrated data modalities such as text, images and audio to deliver enhanced intelligence, robust performance, and domain-specific capabilities for real-world challenges. You will develop and scale reinforcement learning techniques within complex multi-modal architectures, including diffusion-based generative models and autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, as well as resource-efficient models designed for constrained hardware environments. This includes conducting research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, spanning diffusion models for image autoregressive models for multimodal reasoning, and unified multimodal frameworks.

You are expected to have deep expertise in designing multi-modal reinforcement learning systems and a strong background in advanced model architectures, with a hands-on, research-driven approach to building and deploying novel algorithms and training frameworks. You will design and develop RL infrastructure and reward modeling strategies to enable efficient large-scale training, improve training stability, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes. Your responsibilities also include curating multi-modal simulation environments and training datasets, improving baseline policy performance across modalities, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in multi-modal learning and reward optimization. In addition, you will explore next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more directly and effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of unlocking superior, domain-adapted AI performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified frameworks that integrate multiple modalities.

  • Design and build reinforcement learning infrastructure that supports scalable, distributed training across multimodal systems while maintaining efficiency and reliability.

  • Develop and refine reward modeling strategies that improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and mitigate reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create and curate multimodal simulation environments and datasets to support robust training, evaluation, and benchmarking of reinforcement learning systems.

  • Design and conduct rigorous benchmarking and evaluation protocols to measure model performance, track progress against baselines, and validate improvements across multimodal tasks.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate and develop next-generation reinforcement learning paradigms that more effectively learn from environment feedback, with the goal of achieving superior state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance.

  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.


  • A Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required; a PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, or a closely related discipline is preferred, along with a strong track record of AI research and publications in top-tier conferences.

  • Proven experience running large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online RL settings, with demonstrated impact on domain-specific decision-making and measurable improvements in policy performance.

  • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization methods applied to vision and multimodal learning problems, with a focus on improving policy stability, exploration, and sample efficiency in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

  • Strong proficiency in PyTorch and deep learning frameworks for vision and multimodal AI, with hands-on experience building end-to-end RL pipelines covering simulation, training, evaluation, and deployment in production-grade systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to solve core RL challenges in multimodal and vision tasks, such as sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation tradeoffs, and training instability, along with experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on algorithmic improvements to advance agent performance.

  • Proven track record of research publications in top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on designing, building, and scaling intelligent agents across the Microsoft ecosystem. You'll transform defined business use cases into production-ready agentic solutions, leveraging modern AI technologies, Azure services, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) architecture.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and AI leadership to ensure every solution delivers real business value while meeting enterprise standards for security, performance, and governance.

Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

Develop MCP-Based Integrations

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

Contribute to the Agent Ecosystem

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

    • Azure Functions

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

  • Practical experience building or consuming MCP servers.

  • Knowledge of agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as:

    • Semantic Kernel

    • AutoGen

    • Microsoft AI SDKs

  • Experience with:

    • Function and tool calling

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

    • Vector databases

    • Context and memory management

  • Ability to design clear, reliable and secure agent interactions.#

Broader Engineering Skills

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Business Analyst (gn)
description:
Festanstellung bei New Monday · Vollzeit · überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands · gelegentliche Teamtreffen in Essen · Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

Du verstehst komplexe Prozesse, bringst Struktur in Anforderungen und entwickelst daraus konkrete Lösungen? Bei New Monday suchen wir zwei Business Analyst für ein Kundenprojekt, das eine zentrale Herausforderung der Energiewende adressiert: den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen.

Im Projekt entsteht ein Netzanschlusssystem mit drei miteinander verbundenen Anwendungen: einem Kundenfrontend, einem Installateursfrontend und einer Sachbearbeiterlösung. Gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams gestaltest du die fachlichen Grundlagen dafür, die durchgängigen Prozesse effizienter zu machen.

Über New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und begleiten Unternehmen bei der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte – von der ersten Idee über die Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zu Design und technischer Umsetzung. Dafür bringen wir Kompetenzen aus Business Analyse, UX/UI Design und Softwareentwicklung zusammen.

Als Teil von New Monday bringst du deine Expertise direkt in die Projekte unserer Kunden ein. Dort arbeitest du in der Regel als Mitglied des Kundenteams eng mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen, Product Ownern und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du machst komplexe Anforderungen verständlich, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und gestaltest Lösungen, die Nutzer und Unternehmen weiterhelfen.

Dein berufliches Zuhause bleibt New Monday: Wir begleiten dich während deines Projekteinsatzes, unterstützen deine Weiterentwicklung und schaffen Raum für fachlichen Austausch und persönliche Begegnungen im Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du analysierst und strukturierst prozessuale Anforderungen und entwickelst fachliche sowie technische Umsetzungskonzepte.

  • Du übersetzt fachliche Bedarfe in klare, umsetzungsreife Spezifikationen als Grundlage für die technische Realisierung.

  • Du arbeitest dich in komplexe Systemlandschaften und ihre Prozesse ein, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und dokumentierst konkrete Handlungsbedarfe.

  • Du bearbeitest definierte Testpakete, führst Reviews durch und analysierst auftretende Fehler. Dabei dokumentierst und bewertest du Fehlerbilder aus fachlicher Sicht.

  • Du erarbeitest Lösungsoptionen und Handlungsempfehlungen und stimmst diese mit angrenzenden Rollen und Fachbereichen ab.

  • Du behältst den gesamten Prozess über die drei Anwendungen hinweg im Blick und hilfst dabei, den Nutzen der Lösung kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung in der Business Analyse oder im Requirements Engineering für komplexe IT-Projekte.

  • Die Fähigkeit, fachliche und prozessuale Anforderungen systematisch aufzunehmen, zu hinterfragen und verständlich zu dokumentieren.

  • Technisches Verständnis, um Zusammenhänge, Abhängigkeiten und Schnittstellen innerhalb einer Systemlandschaft zu analysieren.

  • Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Spezifikationen und Umsetzungskonzepten sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams.

  • Erfahrung mit fachlichen Tests, Reviews und der Analyse und Bewertung von Fehlern.

  • Eine strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, gemeinsam tragfähige Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Teamtreffen in Essen.

Das erwartet dich bei New Monday

  • Flexibles Arbeiten passend zum Projekt: In diesem Projekt arbeitest du überwiegend remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Gelegentliche Teamtreffen finden vor Ort in Essen statt.

  • Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du organisierst deine Arbeit eigenständig und stimmst dich dabei mit deinem Kundenteam ab. Bei New Monday setzen wir auf kurze Abstimmungswege und Vertrauen.

  • Aufgaben mit Wirkung und Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung direkt im Kundenprojekt ein und gestaltest digitale Prozesse mit, die den Netzausbau und die Integration von Erzeugungsanlagen unterstützen.

  • Persönliche Begleitung im Projekteinsatz: Auch wenn dein Arbeitsalltag überwiegend im Kundenteam stattfindet, bleiben wir mit dir im Austausch und begleiten dich bei Fragen, Herausforderungen und deiner Entwicklung.

  • Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte New-Monday-Team zusammen.

  • Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung.

  • Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir regelmäßig mit dir.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events.

Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.

The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.

Your role

As iOS Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

What you will be doing:

  • Develop and optimize our iOS applications using Swift, with a focus on performance, reliability and user experience.

  • Contribute to application architecture, technical design and the continued development of our modular codebase.

  • Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical solutions early.

  • Create intuitive user interfaces and experiences tailored to iOS devices.

  • Develop and maintain features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, review code and help colleagues make sound implementation decisions.

  • Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including SwiftUI, and assess how they can improve our applications.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience as an iOS or mobile developer.

  • You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.

  • You have experience writing unit tests and/or UI tests for mobile applications.

  • You understand object-oriented software design and architectural patterns such as MVVM.

  • You have experience with web services, cloud technologies and APIs, and are comfortable debugging issues involving memory management, multithreading and networking.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.
