title: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
description:
Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

  • Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

  • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek;

  • Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

  • Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen;

  • De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

  • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

  • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

  • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

  • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

  • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

  • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

  • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Waar ga je het doen?

Campus Installatietechniek is een installatiebedrijf gevestigd in Barneveld. We werken aan uiteenlopende werktuigbouwkundige installaties binnen de utiliteit en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek.Bij Campus houden we van korte lijnen, duidelijke afspraken en een praktische aanpak. We zorgen voor een goede voorbereiding en ondersteunen elkaar waar nodig. Hierdoor kunnen onze monteurs zich richten op hun vak en kunnen projecten efficiënt worden uitgevoerd.

Als Teamleider krijg je de ruimte om mee te denken, verbeteringen door te voeren en jouw eigen stempel te drukken op de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Je werkt samen met betrokken collega's die elkaar kennen, helpen en samen zorgen voor tevreden klanten.

Wij zijn een trots onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (185 bedrijven, 9.000 collega’s), maar opereren met een eigen identiteit en cultuur. Dit betekent dat je bij ons de voordelen van een grote organisatie ervaart – denk aan opleidingsmogelijkheden, een stabiele basis en top secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden – terwijl je tegelijkertijd de vrijheid, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid krijgt om je eigen stempel te drukken bij het lokale bedrijf.

Interesse?

Zie jij jezelf al werken als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties bij Campus Installatietechniek? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Heb je vragen over de functie of wil je direct solliciteren? Neem gerust contact op met Didi Koers, Recruitment Business Partner bij de VDK Groep. Bel of app naar 06-13850963 of mail naar Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: AI Research Scientist – Scientific Evaluation (ML/AI)
description:
Lightly AG is a Zurich-based AI company and ETH/HSG spin-off, backed by Y Combinator and top-tier investors. Our machine learning and computer vision technology is trusted by global leaders in autonomous driving, medical imaging, and visual inspection.

We’re looking for experienced ML/AI researchers with a strong publication track record at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) to support an advanced AI research evaluation project. You'll critically assess scientific papers and research outputs generated by autonomous AI research agents, evaluating their technical correctness, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality against the standards of leading ML/AI conferences.

This is a remote, project-based contractor opportunity with flexible working hours.

Tasks

What you'll be doing

  • What you'll be doing

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated ML/AI research papers, assessing their scientific contributions, technical correctness, methodology, experimental design, and conclusions

  • Assess scientific novelty and significance, determining whether proposed approaches represent meaningful advancements over existing state-of-the-art research

  • Evaluate experimental rigor and validity, including baseline comparisons, benchmark selection, evaluation metrics, statistical evidence, and ablation studies

  • Identify methodological flaws, unsupported claims, inconsistencies, or misleading results that undermine the scientific validity of proposed contributions

  • Assess reproducibility and technical soundness, including whether reported findings are sufficiently supported by experimental evidence and, where available, accompanying code and implementation details

  • Review and verify relevant academic literature, identifying overlooked prior work, inaccurate citations, and unsupported novelty claims

  • Evaluate whether AI-generated research meets the scientific standards of top-tier ML/AI conferences, such as NeurIPS, ICML, and ICLR

  • Provide structured, evidence-based assessments of research quality, including strengths, weaknesses, critical technical concerns, and overall scientific merit

  • Apply detailed evaluation rubrics consistently, providing clear, well-reasoned justifications for your assessments

The project focuses on evaluating advanced AI-generated scientific research, with an emphasis on technical validity, scientific novelty, experimental rigor, and overall research quality. Your role is to provide expert human judgment on whether the resulting research is scientifically valid, genuinely novel, and of a quality comparable to work accepted at leading ML/AI conferences.

Requirements

You're a strong candidate if you:

  • Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent demonstrated research expertise

  • Have published at least 3 peer-reviewed research papers at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR (hard requirement), ideally including first-author or significant research contributions

  • Have substantial hands-on ML/AI research experience, including developing novel methods, designing experiments, analyzing results, and publishing original scientific work

  • Have a strong understanding of scientific methodology and experimental rigor, including appropriate baselines, statistical validity, benchmark design, ablation studies, and reproducibility

  • Can independently assess the novelty, significance, and technical soundness of advanced ML/AI research, identifying both meaningful scientific contributions and fundamental methodological weaknesses

  • Have experience reviewing research papers for top-tier ML/AI conferences or journals, ideally NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR — strongly preferred

  • Are highly familiar with state-of-the-art ML/AI research and can critically assess new methods against existing literature and established benchmarks

  • Are comfortable verifying scientific claims, including reviewing technical arguments, experimental evidence, citations, and, where relevant, code implementations

  • Have strong analytical and scientific writing skills and can articulate nuanced technical judgments through concise, evidence-based feedback

  • Can consistently apply detailed evaluation guidelines and scoring rubrics while exercising independent expert judgment

  • Have exceptional attention to detail, particularly when identifying subtle methodological flaws, unsupported conclusions, or discrepancies between claims and evidence

Benefits

  • Fully remote and flexible — work from anywhere

  • Part-time contractor role with flexible hours

  • Work on the evaluation of cutting-edge autonomous AI systems capable of conducting end-to-end scientific research

  • Apply your research expertise to help assess and advance the scientific capabilities of frontier AI agents

Send us your CV along with a brief note about your research background, areas of expertise, and publication record. Please include links to at least 3 peer-reviewed publications at NeurIPS, ICML, and/or ICLR, as well as any relevant academic peer-review experience.

If applicable, we'd also love to know which ML/AI research areas you're most familiar with and whether you've served as a reviewer, area chair, or in a similar capacity at major research conferences.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance
description:
About the Team

The Strategic Finance team is responsible for shaping the company’s financial strategy and plays a critical role in capital allocation decisions to align financial goals with broader business and mission objectives.

The Strategic Finance Data Science function has four core priorities: (1) accurately and credibly forecast our key business and financial metrics; (2) ensure attainment of key targets; (3) support complex modeling and analyses for business decision-making; and (4) scale recurring work and analysis through automation and dashboarding.

About the Role

The Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance will partner closely with the rest of the Strategic Finance team as well as the Product and GTM Data Science organizations to execute on core business priorities. You will report to the VP of Strategic Finance and work closely with finance leadership to drive data driven decision-making, improve data fluency of those around you, and move the needle on financial outcomes. This is a managerial role. 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop accurate forecasts for product usage and revenue, compute consumption and their underlying drivers, allowing for real-time tracking of key metrics performance and trajectory.

 - Become an expert in OAI’s data and systems, through partnership with Data Engineering, Finance, and other Data Science teams.

 - Design and deliver dashboards for key metrics that impact financial performance.

 - Lead metrics reviews with Strategic Finance and finance leadership to interpret trends from aforementioned dashboards and surface actionable insights.

 - Drive automation of standardized reporting, analysis, and processes across our various revenue segments and compute spend.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing team.

 - Support critical business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline (Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, or CS).

 - 12+ years of experience in a Data Science role at a dynamic and outcome-driven organization.

 - Proficiency in critical analytical tools including SQL.

 - Extensive experience building production-ready models for time series applications.

 - Built adjustable and explainable forecast models for multiple planning cycles.

 - Experience conducting open-ended research projects on new forecasting methodologies.

 - Exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights for leadership.

 - Excellent communication skills and “storytelling” ability when presenting data insights.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. That means being flexible and willing to jump in and do whatever it takes to be successful.

 - Knowledge of Python.

 - Prior management experience.

description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno is growing fast, and we’re hiring Staff and Senior Software Engineers to build and scale the foundational systems that power our data platform and personalized recommendations. You’ll design and operate infrastructure that ingests, processes, and serves PBs of data, helping connect listeners with music they love while supporting analytics, experimentation, and machine learning across the company.

This is a high-impact, senior role at the intersection of Data Infrastructure and ML. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data, and ML teams to build the pipelines, feature infrastructure, and low-latency data services that power recommendations and music discovery. Your work will help turn user interactions and content signals into reliable, fresh data for model training and real-time personalization.

As Suno grows, you’ll help define the long-term architecture of our data platform, balancing scalability, reliability, latency, and cost. You’ll build systems that are observable and easy to extend, enabling teams to experiment quickly and improve how people discover and engage with music. You’ll own major systems end to end, from design through production operation, and drive architecture and technical direction across teams.

Check out the Suno version of this role here: https://suno.com/s/yt9eiMi9aj0rmGX6




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build and scale the data infrastructure behind personalized recommendations and music discovery, working closely with ML and product engineers.

 - Design streaming pipelines that transform user interactions and content signals into fresh features for recommendation models.

 - Develop infrastructure for computing, storing, and serving features across offline model training and online inference, with attention to consistency, reliability, and latency.

 - Enable recommendation experimentation through reliable impression and interaction logging, supporting model evaluation and measurement of recommendation quality.

 - Own the architecture and reliability of core streaming and batch infrastructure, using technologies such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, Flink, and Glue.

 - Build and maintain data workflows and orchestration using Dagster, ensuring pipelines are modular, testable, and observable.

 - Partner with backend and product engineers to define event schemas, data contracts, and ingestion patterns from production systems.

 - Improve the reliability and observability of data pipelines through monitoring, alerting, lineage tracking, and automated recovery mechanisms.

 - Optimize pipelines and storage for performance, cost efficiency, and scalability across AWS and Snowflake.

 - Implement infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) to manage AWS and Snowflake resources in a consistent, reproducible way.

 - Contribute to data platform standards, including schema evolution, data quality enforcement, and pipeline reliability best practices.

 - Lead technical design discussions and help shape the future architecture of Suno’s data platform.

 - Mentor other engineers and raise the bar for engineering quality, reliability, and maintainability.
   


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 7+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, data infrastructure, or distributed systems.

 - Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, and experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems.

 - Deep experience building and operating real-time streaming and batch processing systems.

 - Experience building data or serving infrastructure for recommendations, personalization, search, or similar ML-powered product experiences.

 - Understanding of feature computation, online/offline data consistency, and the latency and freshness requirements of production ML systems.

 - Experience with streaming and cloud data infrastructure, such as Flink, Kinesis, Kafka, or equivalent technologies.

 - Experience designing reliable, observable systems, including monitoring, logging, alerting, and recovery.

 - Strong understanding of data modeling, schema evolution, and data quality.

 - Ability to collaborate closely with ML, data, and product engineering teams, make pragmatic technical decisions, and deliver in ambiguous environments.

 - A strong sense of ownership, with a track record of delivering scalable infrastructure and improving engineering practices.

Excitement about music, creativity, and AI, and the infrastructure that helps people create and discover music.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with AWS services such as Kinesis, Firehose, Lambda, S3, and Glue.

 - Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including performance and cost optimization.

 - Experience with Dagster, Airflow, or similar orchestration frameworks.

 - Experience with dbt for transformations, testing, and modular data modeling.

 - Experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools.
   


ADDITIONAL NOTES

 - Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

 - This role requires working from our Cambridge, MA or New York, NY office five days per week.




COMPENSATION

The annual salary range for this role is $228,960 - 363,510 + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)





PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Senior Technical Director, Live Operations
Applied AI Delivery Lead - Mountain View
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption.



You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth.



This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption.

 - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams.

 - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving.

 - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage.

 - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved.

 - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing.

 - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams.






WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners.

 - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes.

 - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks.

 - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions.

 - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly.

 - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth.

 - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual

title: Sales Manager, Startups
description:
About the team

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

About the role

Startups are creating many of the most disruptive and category-defining AI applications. The Startup Go To Market team’s mission is to help startups harness the power of AI models to drive these advances. You will lead a team that supports startups building effectively with OpenAI’s APIs, providing access to OpenAI teams and expertise to support their growth.

This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and strategy.

This leadership role will be responsible for driving and implementing the sales strategy within our startups segment, recruiting and leading a team of technical sales professionals, and achieving successful deployments with startup customers. 

The ideal candidate will possess significant sales leadership experience and a comprehensive  understanding of AI technologies. This leader will have the capability to adapt to a complex and fast-changing technology environment. Responsibilities will include customer acquisition, account management, owning executive relationships, and more.

This individual will need to be a proven leader who can effectively collaborate cross-functionally with product, marketing, developer relations, operations, and core GTM teams, while guiding and mentoring a sales team towards achieving business objectives.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you'll:

 - Lead a team of sellers 

 - Partner with solutions to build and execute complex customer programs and projects

 - Manage consumption revenue forecasts

 - Contribute to the development of programs and strategic initiatives focused on startup customers

 - Serve as an advocate for improving the startup experience building with OpenAI, synthesizing product feedback from insights captured from our work with startups

 - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies

 - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates

 - Support the development of company culture

We're seeking someone with experience including:

 - 8+ years leading Sales teams

 - Deep experience working in the startup ecosystem either as a founder, early startup employee, or by working with startup customers

 - Selling platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service at a product-led growth company

 - Designing and executing complex deal strategies

 - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance startups

 - Leading high-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.)

 - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

 - Reporting on customer success activities

You might thrive in this role if you: 

 - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their internal productivity and AI strategy. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. 

 - Have a passion for or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

 -  Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. 

 - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions. 

 - Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.

Director of Platform Engineering
description:
Patreon is a media and community platform where over 300,000 creators give their biggest fans access to exclusive work and experiences. We offer creators a variety of ways to engage with their fans and build a lasting business including: paid memberships, free memberships, community chats, live video, and selling to fans directly with one-time purchases.



Ultimately our goal is simple: fund the creative class. And we're leaders in that space, with:

 - $10 billion+ generated by creators since Patreon's inception

 - 100 million+ free memberships for fans who may not be ready to pay just yet, and

 - 25 million+ paid memberships on Patreon today.

We're continuing to invest heavily in building the best creator platform with the best team in the creator economy and are looking for a Director of Platform Engineering to support our mission.



This role is based in New York or San Francisco and open to those who are able to be in-office 2 days per week on a hybrid work model.



About the Team

We’re looking for a Director of Platform Engineering to lead the teams responsible for the core infrastructure and platform services that power Patreon’s product and ecosystem.

This role is ideal for a senior engineering leader who has:

 - Scaled a consumer, UGC, or marketplace platform to millions of users

 - Led infrastructure and/or platform teams supporting product engineering at scale

 - Operated in environments with high availability, bursty traffic, and complex distributed systems

You’ll partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and Product Engineering leaders to ensure Patreon’s platform is reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.



About the Role

 - Lead and grow multiple Platform & Infrastructure Engineering teams, including backend services, APIs, developer platforms, reliability foundations and AI enablement

 - Own the technical strategy and roadmap for scaling Patreon’s platform as usage, content, and integrations grow

 - Drive platform initiatives across:
   
   - Core backend services & APIs
   
   - Service reliability, availability, and performance
   
   - Platform scalability and capacity planning
   
   - Internal developer tooling and productivity

 - Partner with product engineering teams to enable faster feature delivery while maintaining platform stability

 - Establish strong operational excellence (on-call, incident response, SLAs, SLOs)

 - Hire, develop, and mentor senior engineering managers and technical leaders

 - Communicate clearly with executives and cross-functional partners about risks, tradeoffs, and platform investments



About You

Required:

 - 10+ years of engineering experience with 5+ years in engineering management

 - Experience leading platform, infrastructure, or foundational backend teams

 - Proven track record scaling a consumer product, UGC platform, or marketplace to millions of users

 - Strong background in distributed systems, APIs, and service-oriented architectures

 - Experience operating production systems with high availability and performance requirements

Preferred:

 - Background in developer platforms, internal tooling, or platform abstractions

 - Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), data pipelines, and event-driven systems

 - Experience leading through major architectural transitions or scale inflection points



About Patreon

Patreon powers creators to do what they love and get paid by the people who love what they do. Our team is passionate about making this mission and our core values come to life every day in our work. Through this work, our Patronauts:

 - Put Creators First | They’re the reason we’re here. When creators win, we win.

 - Build with Craft | We sign our name to every deliverable, just like the creators we serve.

 - Make it Happen | We don’t quit. We learn and deliver.

 - Win Together | We grow as individuals. We win as a team.

We hire talented and passionate people from different backgrounds because workplace diversity and inclusion is critical to our ability to serve creators worldwide. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t match with every bullet point outlined above, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re a creator at heart, are energized by our mission, and share our company values, we’d love to hear from you.



Patreon is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please let us know via email at accommodations@patreon.

Patreon offers a competitive benefits package including and not limited to salary, equity plans, healthcare, flexible time off, company holidays and recharge days, commuter benefits, lifestyle stipends, learning and development stipends, patronage, parental leave, and 401k plan with matching.

Patreon operates under a hybrid work model, where employees based in office locations are expected to come into the office two days per week, excluding sick time and paid leave. The goal of this policy is to be  intentional about the in-person time we spend together to strengthen the feeling of community at Patreon. Candidates hired into remote-eligible roles are not expected to meet the same requirements.

At Patreon, we believe in fair and transparent pay. In compliance with New York and California pay transparency laws, we are sharing the expected salary range for this role.

The posted salary range is dependent on the location and the level. This range may encompass multiple levels within the role’s job family. The final offer will be based on candidate’s experience, skills, competencies, and geographic location, aligning with the appropriate job level within Patreon’s leveling framework. For remote employees located outside CA and NY, salary may vary based on location and local market conditions.

Patreon reserves the right to modify or update compensation and benefits at any time.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The ChatGPT Learning team creates the next generation of learning experiences within ChatGPT. Millions of people use ChatGPT each week to explore concepts, practice skills, and work through challenges, making learning one of the platform’s largest consumer use cases.

We want ChatGPT to support sustained learning and progress over time, beyond answering individual questions. We’re exploring how AI can make powerful learning tools more accessible, helping people understand the world, develop skills, and pursue their goals.

Our work brings together product engineering, design, AI research, and education to serve learners around the world.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Principal Software Engineer on the ChatGPT Learning team, you will set technical direction and lead the design and development of products that help millions of people learn with ChatGPT.

You’ll remain hands-on across the stack, building polished interfaces and scalable backend services. Working closely with product managers, designers, researchers, and platform teams, you’ll bring new model capabilities into everyday learning experiences.

You’ll drive product and design decisions alongside your cross-functional partners, helping define what we build, how it works, and how it serves learners. We’re looking for an engineer with strong product judgment who can turn ambiguous opportunities into clear direction, lead complex initiatives from concept through launch, and raise the quality of the team’s technical work.

This position is based in San Francisco or New York City, with three days each week in the office. Relocation assistance is available to new employees.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead end-to-end development of learning experiences in ChatGPT, from early exploration through production and iteration.

 - Drive product and design decisions with product managers and designers, bringing technical insight, user feedback, and sound judgment to priorities and tradeoffs.

 - Set technical direction for complex initiatives and guide architecture decisions that support rapid experimentation and long-term reliability.

 - Build multimodal learning capabilities that combine text, images, voice, and interactive interfaces.

 - Develop scalable services and APIs to support learning features throughout ChatGPT.

 - Work with researchers, platform teams, designers, and engineers to prototype ideas and bring new AI capabilities to users.

 - Improve performance, reliability, and usability across ChatGPT’s learning surfaces, using experiments and user feedback to guide improvements.

 - Support other engineers through mentorship, code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping high-quality products across the full stack.

 - Have led complex technical initiatives and made architecture decisions that balance product needs, development speed, and maintainability.

 - Have experience driving product and design decisions in close partnership with product managers and designers.

 - Enjoy building consumer products and taking ownership from initial concept through production.

 - Bring clarity to ambiguous problems and translate them into practical product solutions.

 - Have strong product engineering instincts and care deeply about the quality of the user experience.

 - Have experience building interactive educational tools or learning products.

title: Principal Software Engineer, Productivity
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connector Ecosystem team builds the platform and product experiences that let people extend ChatGPT and Codex. We work on plugins, skills, connectors, interactive apps, and open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We make plugins easy to discover, install, and use, ensure they’re invoked at the right time, and help people find new ways to get value from them.

We want anyone to be able to turn a useful workflow into a plugin, share it, and have other people use it. A plugin can package instructions and skills with connections to the tools and data it needs. Our work spans creation and publishing, reliable execution across our products, clear permissions and approvals, and the controls admins need to bring plugins to their organizations. We work closely with research to improve tool quality as models evolve.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a product-minded Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction, build the systems behind plugins, and improve how models use them. Depending on your focus, you may scale generalist infrastructure and identity-related integrations across products, improve plugin quality at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, or work on the product experience itself to drive plugin usage. You’ll lead complex initiatives across teams and own problems from diagnosis and design through implementation and release.

You’ll remain hands-on while driving product and design decisions alongside Product, Design, Research, and engineering partners. You’ll help shape what we build and how it works, translate user and developer needs into clear priorities, and guide technical decisions that balance rapid iteration with long-term reliability and maintainability.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL

 - Set technical direction and lead complex initiatives across the Plugin Ecosystem, aligning architecture and execution across teams.

 - Drive product and design decisions with cross-functional partners, helping define priorities and shape intuitive experiences for users and developers.

 - Design and ship APIs, SDKs, and services that developers use to extend ChatGPT and Codex.

 - Build intuitive experiences that help users discover, install, and use plugins to get more done.

 - Make plugins easier to create, test, publish, update, and share.

 - Improve when and how models use plugins, from choosing the right plugin to completing a task. Work with Research to diagnose failures and measure improvements as models evolve.

 - Improve plugin reliability and interaction quality across ChatGPT and Codex, including interactive apps, with clear error messages and recovery paths.

 - Build consistent permissions, approvals, and admin controls that help individuals and organizations confidently adopt plugins.

 - Work with developers and partners to turn recurring problems into improvements to the platform, tooling, and documentation.

 - Collaborate across engineering, Product, Research, Security, and Trust & Safety to scale plugin infrastructure and deliver safe, reliable execution.

 - Raise the engineering bar through mentorship, thoughtful code reviews, and clear technical guidance.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

 - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of building and shipping products or platforms that people and developers rely on.

 - Have led complex technical initiatives across teams and driven product and design decisions in close partnership with product managers and designers.

 - Care about product quality and can make complex capabilities feel intuitive, from discovering a useful plugin to completing a task with it.

 - Have strong opinions about APIs and abstractions, and can explain the tradeoffs behind your decisions. Experience with identity, permissions, or integration-heavy systems is especially valuable.

 - Enjoy talking with users and developers, understanding what they’re trying to accomplish, and turning recurring problems into product and platform improvements.

 - Can move between product questions and technical details, collaborate across teams, and take an ambiguous problem through to production.

 - Are comfortable working across web interfaces and backend systems. Experience building applied AI systems, diagnosing model–tool interactions, and measuring reliability and quality is especially valuable.

 - Have built products people rely on or software that other developers use, such as an API or SDK, an open-source project, a developer platform, or internal tools with real users.

title: Researcher, Misalignment Monitoring Lead
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI's Safety Research organization works to ensure that our most capable AI models can be deployed safely and responsibly. As frontier models become increasingly capable and autonomous, developing reliable ways to monitor their behavior, identify emerging risks, and evaluate the effectiveness of safety systems becomes increasingly important.

Our work focuses on advancing the research and evaluation methods needed to understand model behavior and ensure that monitoring systems remain effective as model capabilities evolve. We combine rigorous empirical research with practical safety interventions, working closely with research, engineering, and deployment teams to translate findings into improvements across OpenAI's models and products.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a senior researcher to lead technical work on misalignment monitoring for frontier AI systems. You will develop methods to evaluate the effectiveness of AI monitors, understand their limitations, and improve our ability to detect and stop concerning model behavior reliably.

This role combines research leadership with hands-on technical execution. You will set research priorities, design rigorous evaluations, investigate monitoring failures, and develop approaches for stress-testing and improving monitoring systems. A key focus will be understanding where monitors produce false positives, miss important behaviors, or become less effective as models grow more capable.

You will work closely with researchers and engineers across OpenAI to turn monitoring research into practical improvements to our safety systems. We are looking for someone with strong research judgment, technical depth, and the ability to independently drive ambiguous problems from initial investigation through measurable results.


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Lead the research and technical direction for evaluating and improving the misalignment monitoring of frontier AI systems.

 - Design and execute rigorous evaluations that measure monitor effectiveness, identify failure modes, and assess the reliability of monitoring signals.

 - Develop methods to stress-test and red-team monitors, including identifying behaviors that evade detection or expose weaknesses in existing approaches.

 - Investigate false positives, missed detections, and other monitoring failures to improve the accuracy and usefulness of safety evaluations.

 - Build scalable evaluation frameworks and experimental tools that enable ongoing measurement of monitoring performance as model capabilities evolve.

 - Translate research findings into actionable improvements, working with partner teams to strengthen monitoring systems and inform broader safety decisions.

 - Establish research priorities and guide technical execution, balancing foundational research questions with practical deployment needs.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have a strong background in machine learning research, particularly in model evaluations, AI safety, alignment, robustness, or related areas.

 - Have demonstrated the ability to lead technically challenging research projects, from identifying important questions through designing experiments and delivering results.

 - Bring strong experimental judgment and understand how to design evaluations that are rigorous, reproducible, and difficult to game.

 - Have hands-on experience building or evaluating machine learning systems, including working with large language models or other frontier AI systems.

 - Enjoy investigating complex failure modes and developing methods to distinguish meaningful safety signals from misleading measurements.

 - Are comfortable working on open-ended research problems where the right methodology or success criteria may not be obvious at the outset.

 - Combine strong research instincts with practical engineering ability and can independently build experiments, analyze results, and iterate quickly.

 - Communicate technical findings clearly and enjoy collaborating across research, engineering, and safety teams.

 - Are motivated by OpenAI's mission and the challenge of developing reliable oversight mechanisms for increasingly capable AI systems.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with AI monitoring, automated evaluations, adversarial testing, or red-teaming.

 - Research experience in scalable oversight, AI control, model behavior analysis, or interpretability.

 - Experience developing monitoring or evaluation systems that are used in real-world deployments.

 - A track record of technical research leadership, including mentoring researchers or coordinating cross-functional research initiatives.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. Role Overview
As a Member of Technical Staff in Post-Training Data Infrastructure, you will build and own the pipelines that produce the post-training data for our large language models (LLMs), from SFT and RL data to synthetic and human-annotated data. You will work closely with researchers and annotation teams so they can iterate on data as quickly as they iterate on models.

 - Collaborate with researchers and engineers to make sure data pipelines keep pace with the needs of cutting-edge language models.
   
   

Qualifications

 - Strong software engineering skills.

 - Experience designing and building large-scale data pipelines for machine learning, ideally for LLM post-training.

 - Track record of running distributed data processing and model inference at scale.

 - Good understanding of post-training methods (e.g., SFT, RLHF, DPO) and how data shapes model behaviour.

 - Excellent communication skills.

title: Director of Engineering - Traffic & Networking
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a visionary Director of Traffic and Networking to lead the group responsible for the very circulatory system of our global cloud infrastructure.




THE MISSION

Every query, every login, every byte of data in Snowflake's Data Cloud travels through the systems this team builds. The Traffic & Networking group is responsible for the ingress, egress, domain management, and internal networking layers that connect thousands of customers to Snowflake across public and private connectivity paths. We build and deploy software to enable seamless service-to-service and user-to-service communication across all traffic types spanning every environment and cloud provider Snowflake touches. Your goal is to ensure robust domain management, efficient traffic flow, and reliable connectivity while relentlessly improving product velocity, and operational efficiency.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a senior engineering leader at Snowflake, you will be expected to:

 - Set the Strategic Vision: Define the roadmap for Snowflake’s networking foundation and be accountable for the execution of complex plans and deliverables.

 - Scale Infrastructure: Guide your team in building software solutions that automate and scale networking across multiple cloud providers including AWS, Azure, and GCP.

 - Drive Innovation: Lead projects from initial idea through design and implementation, collaborating with teams in the US, Ireland, Poland, and beyond.

 - Technical Leadership: Provide deep technical expertise with a focus on high-performance, security, and the abstraction of complex cloud networking layers.

 - Build the Team: Actively recruit, hire, and grow a diverse team of industry veterans and rising stars.

 - Mentorship: Be responsible for the career development of your reports through continuous coaching and mentorship.

 - Operational Excellence: Shift resources dynamically to respond to production issues and customer needs, ensuring high levels of reliability.


YOUR PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

We are looking for an exceptional leader who views infrastructure through a product development lens.

 - Experience: 15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering management leading leaders.

 - Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record in designing systems and managing large-scale production infrastructure with a focus on networking, compute, or storage

 - Cloud Fluency: Strong hands-on experience with cloud service providers.

 - SaaS Background: Deep experience working at scale within a multi-tenant or multi-single-tenant SaaS model, handling billions of complex queries and massive traffic ingress/egress.

 - Communication: Excellent collaboration skills to bridge the gap between complex networking requirements and cross-functional business goals.

 - Education: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.


WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?

 - Impact: You're actively evolving a network architecture, building new observability capabilities, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and designing the next-generation connectivity model across multiple clouds. Every Snowflake team depends on what this group ships. Infrastructure is our product.

 - Growth: This role will push your technical and leadership boundaries in an environment that values practical decision-making and creativity.

 - Security First: You will play a critical role in upholding Snowflake’s high standards for data security and confidentiality.

 - Builder's Culture: We ship our own proxy infrastructure, our own service discovery, our own network automation. This is a build role for someone who wants to own the full traffic stack.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Staff Security GRC Analyst to build Suno's security compliance program from the ground up. You'll report to our CISO, work alongside our AppSec and InfraSec teams, and own the control framework that ties everything together: which controls we have, how they map to SOC 2 and NIST CSF, and whether they actually work. You're as comfortable reading a cloud config as an audit standard, and you'd rather automate evidence collection with AI than chase screenshots. It's a greenfield build with real stakes and a direct line to leadership.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/8U6fbhqLEghsnRsm




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own Suno's security control framework, mapping controls to SOC 2, NIST CSF, and future frameworks, and writing control descriptions with the teams who run them.

 - Lead SOC 2 preparation end to end, from gap assessments and readiness tracking to driving remediation with control owners and working with our external auditor.

 - Automate evidence collection and control monitoring with scripts, integrations, and AI tools, deciding where human review stays in the loop.

 - Run vendor security reviews, keep our security policies current, and answer customer security questionnaires alongside Product and Legal.

 - Partner with the CISO to give leadership and the board a clear, evidence-backed view of our security posture, and lay the foundations of GRC as part of a growing Security team.

 - Help earn the trust of the partners and customers who bring Suno to more people, so creating music can be part of everyone's day.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED


MUST-HAVES

 - 7–9 years in GRC, security compliance, or IT audit.

 - Hands-on, end-to-end ownership of a security compliance program as its primary owner, ideally including taking a company through its first SOC 2.

 - Deep working knowledge of SOC 2 and NIST CSF, including control mapping, audit mechanics (design vs. operating effectiveness, sampling, evidence), and staying current as requirements evolve.

 - Enough technical fluency to read a cloud configuration, access setup, or pipeline and judge whether it enforces what the control says. You don't need to write production code.

 - Comfort building your own automation with scripts or AI tools.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience standing up continuous controls monitoring or automated evidence collection, including what it covered and what changed as a result.

 - Experience applying LLMs to assurance work, such as control drafting, framework mapping, or evidence testing.

 - Experience with cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, and with a modern GRC platform.

 - Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or CRISC.

title: Product Manager, Financial Services
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI is building AI products for serious professional work. We’re going deep on finance with a committed team focused on unlocking the potential of AI in this vertical: working closely with industry experts and users to build bespoke solutions that help finance professionals do real work.

OpenAI’s Financial Services team works closely with customers to understand where AI can improve the economics and quality of financial work: faster diligence, broader research coverage, sharper client materials, more accurate models, and better investment analysis. Our work spans workflows across investment banking, equity research, private equity, asset management, wealth management, insurance, and other parts of finance. We bring together OpenAI’s models, financial data, and enterprise knowledge to build products that fit how financial professionals work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Manager to help define and build OpenAI’s financial services products. Reporting to the GM of Financial Services, you will own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key experiences, taking them from customer discovery and early prototypes through launch, adoption, and iteration. This is a hands-on role. You will spend time with bankers, investors, analysts, and other finance professionals; build and test early product experiences; and work closely with Engineering, Design, Research, and customer-facing teams to ship. You should have strong judgment about both the product experience and the work it produces. You will also form a vision for how AI can change the financial services space and can translate that into product execution.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Own product strategy and priorities. Work with the GM to identify the most valuable customer problems and translate them into a clear roadmap. Make decisions about what to build, what to defer, and where partners or shared OpenAI capabilities can best meet the need.

 - Go deep on financial workflows. Sit with customers, observe how they work, and understand the documents they create, data they trust, tools they use, and standards they apply. Use those insights to design experiences that customers return to in their daily work.

 - Build and ship. Create working prototypes, demos, example outputs, and product requirements using Codex and other OpenAI tools. Partner with Engineering and Design to turn early concepts into reliable products, resolve dependencies, and drive delivery through launch and iteration.

 - Raise the bar for quality and trust. Work with Research and Engineering to turn real finance tasks and product failures into evaluations, datasets, and model feedback. Define what good looks like across accuracy, source traceability, completeness, and ease of review, while making practical tradeoffs across quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

 - Make products work inside financial institutions. Translate integration, data-access, privacy, security, and review requirements into product decisions. Work across Legal, Security, Partnerships, and core product teams to address deployment barriers and determine which needs require finance-specific solutions.

 - Measure results and drive adoption. Define success through task completion, output acceptance, repeat usage, time saved, and business impact. Combine product data, evaluations, and customer feedback to guide investment. Partner with GTM and customer-facing teams on pilots, onboarding, and launches, then use what you learn to improve the product.


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have a track record of taking complex products from discovery through launch and sustained adoption, as a product manager, founder, or builder with substantial product ownership.

 - Understand financial work well enough to earn credibility with demanding practitioners. You may have built products for financial institutions or worked directly in investment banking, investing, equity research, corporate development, or related fields.

 - Combine strong product taste with attention to detail. You care about making complex workflows feel simple and can judge both the experience and the quality of its outputs.

 - Work comfortably with engineers and researchers on model behavior, data quality, integrations, and evaluations. You can distinguish a model limitation from a data, workflow, or product-design problem.

 - Use AI deeply in your own work and build prototypes to test ideas. You are willing to teach, onboard, debug, and inspect outputs alongside customers.

 - Know how to choose useful goals and metrics, test assumptions, and change priorities when the evidence changes.

 - Bring sound judgment about privacy, trust, and accuracy in consequential professional work.

Our Tax team owns Patreon's global tax obligations end to end, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and the rest of Finance to build scalable processes that keep pace with a fast-growing, international creator platform.

The Director, Indirect Tax is responsible for all indirect taxes across all aspects of the business. Think marketplace sales taxes, ESS, VAT, GST, JCT, etc. This role will be very hands-on and play an integral part in all aspects of tax operations, from collections through remittance. As a Director, you will work closely with Product and Engineering teams as well as the Finance team, to scope, design, and enhance the way our product handles indirect taxes.

 - Be able to clearly explain our tax obligations to internal and external stakeholders, and help build a path towards full compliance with those obligations.

 - Act as a first point of contact for organization and Creator/Patron tax queries. Help develop resources to allow Patrons and Creators to understand and comply with tax obligations across the world. Do the best we can to demystify what should be a pain-free and straightforward process.

 - Keep abreast of legislative updates and initiate changes on our platform to ensure compliance.

 - Manage tax controversies, including providing response to various information document requests from tax authorities, coordinate with local tax advisors on reviews, strategize the audit plan and quantify tax/reserve impact to financial statements.

 - Prepare monthly account reconciliations and reporting schedules, providing commentary and variance analysis.

 - Work closely with management and external auditors to ensure the company is compliant with the latest accounting guidance, FAS 5 reserves and SOX.

 - Research and analysis identifying and exploring indirect tax opportunities and exposures related to global footprint expansion, systems and controls, refunds and cash flow management and projections.

 - 10–12+ years experience in indirect tax.

 - Prior experience with electronically supplied service providers and marketplace providers.

 - Strong experience and knowledge in U.S. GAAP, FAS 5, and internal controls.

 - Experience with informational reporting (Forms 1099, 5471, etc.).

 - Direct prior experience with interpretation and application of developing law.

 - Proven success in tax controversy management and settlement.

 - Previous experience performing tax research and providing technical advice on U.S. state and international tax issues.

 - Self-starter, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and responsibilities.

 - Team leader, able to shepherd projects from beginning to end.

 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

 - Detail-oriented and able to effectively organize and manage multiple responsibilities.

 - High level of honesty, integrity, commitment, and responsibility to day-to-day work.

 - Superior written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal skills.

 - Experience with NetSuite; outsourced sales tax providers a plus.

title: Principal Software Engineer II - Next-Gen Data Transformations
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Principal Engineer II to architect the core data processing engine of the Snowflake Data & AI Cloud. At Snowflake, we believe that high-performance, unified compute fabrics are the indispensable building blocks for Agentic AI. Autonomous agents require more than just models; they require a high-fidelity, low-latency state layer to reason, act, and persist context. This role is not about building traditional data processing pipelines or legacy ETL/ELT workflows; it is about building the core distributed systems and atomic primitives that make those agentic workflows possible.

In this role, you will be a lead architect of the Snowflake Data Transformation Engine. You will design and implement the fundamental transformations infrastructure—Stateful Stream Processing Engines, Incremental View Maintenance Engine, Materialization Internals, and the Distributed Orchestration Fabric. Our solid foundation supporting the seamless transition for enterprises between batch and streaming through Dynamic Tables, Streams & Tasks, and DBT Projects is the starting point. Your architectural work will extend the reach of the core engine to accelerate and support the massive scale of the Snowpark and Spark ecosystems. You are building the systems that allow both data engineers and autonomous agents to process exabytes of data with sub-second state propagation and absolute transactional integrity across the Snowflake Data Cloud.

As a Principal Engineer II, you will own the technical vision for the Data Transformation umbrella of capabilities. Your work on streaming internals and declarative state management provides the architectural substrate for high-performance customer features processing. This foundational technology is engineered to drive low-latency, high-throughput data transformations at a massive scale to empower enterprises to build and scale complex applications, including autonomous agentic loops. This infrastructure enables our broader ecosystem to operate on live, governed data, ensuring that the core engine primitives we build translate directly into superior data freshness and processing efficiency for every customer.


AS A PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

 - Architect Foundation Primitives for Agentic AI Data Engineering: Design the internal engines for Dynamic Tables, Streams, and Tasks, ensuring the underlying processing kernels provide the elastic, serverless foundation required for real-time agentic reasoning.

 - Build the Data Transformation Processing Fabric: Develop the low-level infrastructure for automated triggers and incremental processing logic, allowing the Snowflake engine to proactively manage, optimize, and process incoming data without manual intervention.

 - Innovate in System Internals: Drive the long-term roadmap for stateful streaming, moving the industry toward a freshness-first system architecture where data is always ready for model consumption.

 - Displace Legacy Orchestration Layers: Identify how to build superior, native processing capabilities directly within the Snowflake engine to eliminate the complexity of external schedulers, simplifying the architectural scaffolding for our customers.

 - Engineer for Global Scale and Governance: Design and implement highly reliable, multi-tenant system internals that handle exabytes of data while maintaining Snowflake’s industry-leading standards for resource isolation, security, and distributed consistency.

 - Drive Technical Strategy for the AI Era: Provide technical leadership to senior management and multiple departments, influencing how Snowflake’s core compute fabric evolves to support the burgeoning Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous agent ecosystems and modern Python and Spark data processing workflows.

 - Drive Customer Success through Direct Engagement: Partner with Snowflake’s most strategic customers and field engineering teams to translate massive-scale architectural challenges into core engine requirements, ensuring our processing primitives meet the real-world demands of the global Data Cloud.

 - Ensure Operational Excellence: Take responsibility for the operational readiness of the services, meeting the strict commitments to our customers regarding reliability, availability, and performance.


OUR IDEAL PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER II WILL HAVE:

 - 14+ years of industry experience building database systems internals, distributed systems internals, or large-scale data processing engines.

 - Strong Technical Leadership: Operates as a broad architect, setting architectural direction, mentoring senior engineers, and establishing technical standards for large cross-product initiatives, coupled with exceptional ability to navigate organizational complexity, align multiple teams, and drive cross-functional decisions spanning multiple teams

 - Mastery of Systems Programming: Deep expertise in stateful stream processing, incremental view maintenance, distributed transactions, and query execution internals.

 - Infrastructure-First Mindset: You are a systems builder. You prefer building the Operating System and the Engine rather than the application or the end-user pipeline.

 - Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven track record of solving complex problems in consensus, replication, and high-concurrency environments at cloud scale.

 - Ecosystem Awareness: A deep understanding of the architectural limitations of traditional orchestration and data processing tools, and a vision for how to solve those challenges through native Snowflake system design.

 - Collaborative Leadership: Ability to work in a globally distributed environment, collaborate across product and engineering boundaries, and mentor senior and junior engineers alike.

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024.
